rules.title: An issued invoice is never edited or deleted
rules.statement: Once an invoice is issued, neither the invoice nor its billing record is changed or removed. Any correction goes through a later document: a corrective invoice or a void.
rules.why: The billing record is chained and, under VeriFactu, already with AEAT. An edit would make the invoice say something its record does not, and deleting it would leave a hole in the series.

legal_basis.quote: Cualquier necesidad de corrección o anulación de los datos registrados deberá ser realizada mediante al menos un registro de facturación adicional posterior, de forma que se conserven inalterables los datos originalmente registrados.

decision.when: You spot the mistake before issuing: the invoice is still a draft or scheduled.
decision.then: Edit or delete the draft. Nothing has been issued, so nothing needs correcting.

incorrect.text: Patching the amount of an invoice that is already ISSUED: the API answers STATUS_NOT_MODIFIABLE.

correct.text: Issuing a corrective invoice against it, which leaves the original as it was.
correct.code:
POST /v1/companies/{company_id}/invoices/{invoice_id}/corrective

{ "rectification_type": "PARTIAL", "rectification_code": "R1", "reason": "Price agreed after delivery was lower", "lines": [{ "description": "Consulting (adjustment)", "quantity": 1, "unit_price": -100 }] }

rules.title: Only a draft can be issued
rules.statement: Issue an invoice from DRAFT, or create and issue it in one call. Issuing assigns the number, sets the issue date to today and freezes every amount; a scheduled invoice is issued on its date, or returned to draft first.
rules.why: Issuing is the step that creates the fiscal document. Everything the invoice says is fixed at that moment, so it can happen only once and only from a draft.

incorrect.text: Calling the issue operation on a scheduled invoice to send it out today: it answers ONLY_DRAFT_EMITTABLE.

correct.text: Removing the schedule, which returns the invoice to DRAFT, and then issuing it.

rules.title: Test in the sandbox, never with real invoices
rules.statement: Do not issue test invoices with a production key. An invoice issued in production is a real invoice, sent to AEAT and numbered in your series, even if it was meant as a test; one issued by mistake has to be voided.
rules.why: AEAT does not accept fictitious invoices from a billing system in production. A test issued there stays in the series and in AEAT's records, and only a void takes it out of the books.

applies_to.scope: Production API keys (beel_sk_live_…).

legal_basis.norm: AEAT, Aclaraciones a dudas de los desarrolladores (v1.3)
legal_basis.article: 11. Borradores de factura, pre-facturas, facturas proforma, albaranes, facturas de prueba
legal_basis.quote: las facturas de prueba o facturas de formación, elaboradas con un SIF adaptado, siempre que lleguen a ser facturas propiamente hablando (es decir que se generen de forma real, y que no sean simples borradores o prefacturas no confirmadas), deben ser tratadas como si de facturas reales se tratara a los efectos del RD 1007/23 y resto de normativa de desarrollo.

incorrect.text: Running an end-to-end test suite against production that issues invoices to a dummy customer.

correct.text: Running the same suite with a sandbox key (beel_sk_test_…): invoices go to AEAT's test environment and never count.

rules.title: Retry writes with the same Idempotency-Key
rules.statement: Send an Idempotency-Key header on every call that creates, issues, corrects or voids an invoice, and repeat the same key when you retry. A retried request then returns the first response instead of doing the work twice.
rules.why: Without it, a timeout followed by a retry can create or issue a second invoice. An issued duplicate consumes a number and a billing record, and can only be voided.

incorrect.text: Retrying a timed-out create call without a key, or with a new random key on each attempt.

correct.text: Deriving the key from your own order id, so every retry of the same order sends the same key.

rules.title: Duplicating an invoice creates a new one, not a copy
rules.statement: Do not use the duplicate operation to replace a lost or damaged invoice. It creates a new draft that, once issued, is a different invoice with its own number and its own billing record; to hand over an invoice again, download the same PDF.
rules.why: Issuing the copy would invoice the same operation twice, in the series and in AEAT's records.

incorrect.text: The customer lost the invoice, so you duplicate it and issue the copy.

correct.text: You download the PDF of the original invoice again and send it.

rules.title: Void only an invoice that should never have been issued
rules.statement: Void an invoice only when it was issued by mistake: the sale or service it describes never took place, it was a test, or it is an accidental duplicate. An invoice for an operation that did happen is never voided to fix it; it is corrected with a corrective invoice.
rules.why: A void removes the invoice's fiscal effect altogether. Using it on a real operation, even to reissue it right after, takes a real sale out of the books; the law provides the corrective invoice for that.

legal_basis.quote: Procederá la generación de un registro de facturación de anulación cuando se haya emitido erróneamente una factura y sea por lo tanto necesario anular su correspondiente registro de facturación de alta.

legal_basis.norm: AEAT, Aclaraciones a dudas de los desarrolladores (v1.3)
legal_basis.article: 17. Forma de proceder ante errores cometidos al facturar
legal_basis.quote: Con carácter general, todas las facturas emitidas, en la medida en que respondan a operaciones realmente efectuadas (como es el caso habitual) no pueden anularse. En el caso de que exista alguna diferencia entre lo facturado y la realidad, por ejemplo, que por un defecto de cantidades o de calidades, o por otras razones, y se deba modificar su importe, procederá la emisión de una factura rectificativa

decision.when: The invoice should never have been issued: the operation did not take place, it was a test, or it is an accidental duplicate.
decision.then: Void it. Its number stays used; if a valid invoice is still due, issue it as a new one.

incorrect.text: The customer's VAT rate was wrong on an invoice for work you did deliver, so you void it and issue a new one.

correct.text: The same invoice is corrected with a corrective invoice; a duplicate fired twice by a retry is voided.
correct.code:
POST /v1/companies/{company_id}/invoices/{invoice_id}/void

{ "reason": "Duplicate of invoice F-2026-0142, issued twice by mistake" }

rules.title: Void an issued invoice through the void operation; delete a draft
rules.statement: An issued invoice (ISSUED, SENT, PAID or RECTIFIED) is voided only with the void operation, with a reason of 10 to 500 characters. A draft or a scheduled invoice is not voided: it is deleted, and it had no number to lose.
rules.why: The void operation is what records the cancellation and, under VeriFactu, sends it to AEAT; a status change cannot. A second void of the same invoice is refused, so a retried void is safe to treat as done.

incorrect.text: Setting the status to VOIDED with the status operation: it answers CANCELLATION_VIA_SPECIFIC_ENDPOINT.

correct.text: Calling the void operation with the reason.
correct.code:
POST /v1/companies/{company_id}/invoices/{invoice_id}/void

{ "reason": "Invoice issued to the wrong customer" }

rules.title: A void adds a cancellation record; the original stays
rules.statement: Voiding an invoice under VeriFactu generates a cancellation record (registro de anulación) that identifies the original by its number and issue date; the original registration record is never removed. Follow the cancellation as a record of its own, with its own status.
rules.why: AEAT keeps both records, linked. Reading only the invoice's registration status after a void hides whether AEAT accepted the cancellation.

applies_to.scope: Invoices of a company under VeriFactu.

legal_basis.quote: c) El número y, en su caso, serie de la factura correspondiente al registro de facturación de alta que se anule. d) La fecha de expedición de la factura correspondiente al registro de facturación de alta que se anule.

Cualquier necesidad de corrección o anulación de los datos registrados deberá ser realizada mediante al menos un registro de facturación adicional posterior, de forma que se conserven inalterables los datos originalmente registrados.

incorrect.text: Treating the invoice's verifactu.submission_status right after a void as the answer to the cancellation.

correct.text: Listing the invoice's VeriFactu records and reading the VOID record's own status.

rules.title: Wrong data on an issued invoice is fixed with a corrective
rules.statement: Issue a corrective invoice when an issued invoice lacks a required detail, charged the wrong tax, or its taxable base changes after the operation. The corrective is issued against the original, which must be ISSUED, SENT, PAID or RECTIFIED.
rules.why: The law makes the corrective mandatory in these cases, and it is the only way to change what an issued invoice says: the original and its record stay as they were.

legal_basis.quote: Deberá expedirse una factura rectificativa en los casos en que la factura original no cumpla alguno de los requisitos que se establecen en los artículos 6 ó 7 [...] 2. Igualmente, será obligatoria la expedición de una factura rectificativa en los casos en que las cuotas impositivas repercutidas se hubiesen determinado incorrectamente o se hubieran producido las circunstancias que, según lo dispuesto en el artículo 80 de la Ley del Impuesto, dan lugar a la modificación de la base imponible.

decision.when: The sale happened, but the amounts, the tax or a detail on the invoice are wrong.
decision.then: Issue a corrective against it: R1–R4 for a standard invoice, R5 for a simplified one.

incorrect.text: Voiding an invoice for a sale that did happen because it was charged at 10 % instead of 21 %, and issuing a new one.

correct.text: Issuing a corrective against it with rectification_code R1: a TOTAL one that replaces the invoice at the right rate, or a PARTIAL one with the lines that settle the difference.

rules.title: Pick the reason code: R1–R4 for standard invoices, R5 for simplified
rules.statement: Send the rectification_code that matches the cause: R1 for an error founded in law or art. 80 Uno, Dos and Seis LIVA, R2 for insolvency, R3 for bad debt, R4 for the rest. A simplified invoice is always corrected with R5, and R5 corrects nothing else.
rules.why: The code tells AEAT why the base or the tax changed. A standard invoice corrected with R5, or a simplified one with R1–R4, is a record of the wrong type.

legal_basis.quote: R1 Factura Rectificativa (Error fundado en derecho y art. 80 Uno Dos y Seis LIVA). R2 Factura Rectificativa (art. 80.3). R3 Factura Rectificativa (art. 80.4). R4 Factura Rectificativa (Resto). R5 Factura Rectificativa en facturas simplificadas.

legal_basis.norm: AEAT, Preguntas frecuentes SIF y VERI*FACTU
legal_basis.article: Procedimientos de facturación: Tipo de facturas
legal_basis.quote: La rectificación de una factura simplificada se registrará con la clave R5 cualquiera que sea el motivo de la misma.

incorrect.text: Correcting a simplified invoice with R1: the API answers RECTIFICATIVA_R1R4_NOT_SIMPLIFICADA.

correct.text: Correcting the same simplified invoice with R5.

rules.title: A corrective shows the difference or the amounts after the correction
rules.statement: A corrective states the correction either as the difference, whatever its sign, or as the amounts after the correction together with the amount rectified. In the API, PARTIAL carries the difference as lines; TOTAL cancels the original in full and takes no lines, because it copies the original's lines negated.
rules.why: The corrective has to meet every requirement of an invoice and show what changed. A PARTIAL without lines states no correction; a TOTAL with lines would describe a different invoice from the one it cancels.

legal_basis.quote: La factura rectificativa deberá cumplir los requisitos que se establecen en los artículos 6 ó 7, según proceda. Cuando lo que se expida sea una factura rectificativa, los datos a los que se refiere el artículo 6.1.f), g) y h) expresarán la rectificación efectuada. En particular, los datos que se regulan en los párrafos f) y h) del citado artículo 6.1 se podrán consignar, bien indicando directamente el importe de la rectificación, con independencia de su signo, bien tal y como queden tras la rectificación efectuada, señalando igualmente en este caso el importe de dicha rectificación.

incorrect.text: A PARTIAL corrective with no lines: the API answers RECTIFICATIVA_PARCIAL_SIN_LINEAS.

correct.text: The same PARTIAL corrective with the difference as a negative line.

rules.title: The corrective record says whether it substitutes or adds a difference
rules.statement: Every corrective record declares TipoRectificativa S (substitution) or I (differences), and an S record carries the rectified base and tax. BeeL. registers a TOTAL corrective as S and a PARTIAL one as I.
rules.why: AEAT reads the corrective's amounts differently in each mode; a record without the mode, or an S without the rectified amounts, is rejected.

applies_to.scope: VeriFactu enabled.

legal_basis.norm: AEAT, Preguntas frecuentes SIF y VERI*FACTU
legal_basis.article: Procedimientos de facturación: ¿Cómo registra el emisor una factura rectificativa?
legal_basis.quote: Asimismo, se deberá identificar el tipo de factura rectificativa con las claves “S- sustitución” o “I- por diferencias”.

incorrect.text: Building your own corrective record and leaving out the rectified amounts of a substitution.

correct.text: Choosing rectification_type on the request and letting BeeL. build the record: TOTAL goes as S with the original's amounts, PARTIAL as I.

rules.title: A corrective identifies the invoice it rectifies
rules.statement: A corrective states the number and the issue date of the invoice it rectifies. In the API a corrective is always created against its original, the {invoice_id} of the request, and each corrective rectifies one invoice.
rules.why: Without an unambiguous reference to the original, neither the customer nor AEAT can tell what is being corrected.

legal_basis.quote: La rectificación se realizará mediante la emisión de una nueva factura en la que se haga constar los datos identificativos de la factura rectificada.
En caso de facturas rectificativas, la referencia expresa e inequívoca de la factura rectificada y de las especificaciones que se modifican.

incorrect.text: Issuing a standard invoice with negative amounts and the original's number written in the notes.

correct.text: Creating the corrective on the original's own path, so it is linked to it.

rules.title: Issue the corrective as soon as you know, within 4 years
rules.statement: Issue a corrective as soon as you learn of the cause, and never later than 4 years after the tax accrued or, for art. 80 LIVA causes, after the circumstance occurred.
rules.why: Past that deadline the tax charged can no longer be rectified, and a late corrective does not change it.

legal_basis.quote: La expedición de la factura rectificativa deberá efectuarse tan pronto como el obligado a expedirla tenga constancia de las circunstancias que, conforme a los apartados anteriores, obligan a su expedición, siempre que no hubiesen transcurrido cuatro años a partir del momento en que se devengó el Impuesto o, en su caso, se produjeron las circunstancias a que se refiere el artículo 80 de la Ley del Impuesto.

incorrect.text: Correcting in 2026 an invoice whose tax accrued in 2021.

correct.text: Correcting the invoice the month the customer reports the error.

rules.title: A wrong corrective is fixed against the original, not corrected itself
rules.statement: BeeL. does not issue a corrective against another corrective. When a corrective is wrong, issue another corrective against the original invoice.
rules.why: In BeeL. every corrective hangs from one original invoice, so the whole chain of corrections of an invoice stays readable from it.

decision.when: A corrective you already issued is itself wrong.
decision.then: Issue another corrective against the original invoice, not against the corrective.

incorrect.text: Calling the corrective operation with the id of a corrective: the API answers CORRECTIVE_NOT_RECTIFIABLE.

correct.text: Calling it with the id of the original invoice, with the lines that settle the difference.

rules.title: A bad-debt corrective (R3) needs the legal conditions first
rules.statement: Issue an R3 corrective only when the debt is uncollectable in the legal sense: 1 year since the tax accrued without payment (less for smaller businesses), a court claim or notarial demand, and a recipient who is a business or a base above 50 €. Issue it within the following 6 months and report it to AEAT; it does not apply to recipients not established in Spain.
rules.why: Without these conditions the base cannot be reduced, and the tax the corrective gives back is still owed.

applies_to.scope: rectification_code R3.

legal_basis.quote: 1.ª Que haya transcurrido un año desde el devengo del Impuesto repercutido sin que se haya obtenido el cobro de todo o parte del crédito derivado del mismo. [...] 3.ª Que el destinatario de la operación actúe en la condición de empresario o profesional, o, en otro caso, que la base imponible de aquella, Impuesto sobre el Valor Añadido excluido, sea superior a 50 euros. 4.ª Que el sujeto pasivo haya instado su cobro mediante reclamación judicial al deudor o por medio de requerimiento notarial al mismo

B) La modificación deberá realizarse en el plazo de los seis meses siguientes a la finalización del periodo de seis meses o un año a que se refiere la condición 1.ª anterior y comunicarse a la Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria en el plazo que se fije reglamentariamente. [...] Tampoco procederá la modificación de la base imponible cuando el destinatario de las operaciones no esté establecido en el territorio de aplicación del Impuesto, ni en Canarias, Ceuta o Melilla.

decision.when: The customer has not paid, the legal waiting period has passed and you have claimed the debt in court or by notarial demand.
decision.then: Issue an R3 corrective within the legal window and report it to AEAT.

incorrect.text: Issuing an R3 corrective two months after the due date because the customer stopped answering.

correct.text: Issuing it once the waiting period has passed and the debt has been claimed by notarial demand, and filing the communication with AEAT.

rules.title: An insolvency corrective (R2) needs a declaration of insolvency
rules.statement: Issue an R2 corrective only when the customer has not paid the tax charged and, after it accrued, a court has declared the customer insolvent (auto de declaración de concurso).
rules.why: The base can be reduced for insolvency only on that court decision; without it the reduction has no legal footing.

applies_to.scope: rectification_code R2.

legal_basis.quote: La base imponible podrá reducirse cuando el destinatario de las operaciones sujetas al Impuesto no haya hecho efectivo el pago de las cuotas repercutidas y siempre que, con posterioridad al devengo de la operación, se dicte auto de declaración de concurso.

decision.when: The customer has been declared insolvent by a court after the invoice's tax accrued, and has not paid.

incorrect.text: Issuing an R2 corrective because the customer announced it is winding down.

correct.text: Issuing it after the court's declaration of insolvency, keeping a copy of the court order.

rules.title: A provisional price is rectified once the final one is known
rules.statement: When the price was not known when the tax accrued and you invoiced a provisional amount, issue an R1 corrective once the final amount is known.
rules.why: The provisional amount is only an estimate; the tax due is the one on the final price.

applies_to.scope: rectification_code R1.

legal_basis.quote: Si el importe de la contraprestación no resultara conocido en el momento del devengo del impuesto, el sujeto pasivo deberá fijarlo provisionalmente aplicando criterios fundados, sin perjuicio de su rectificación cuando dicho importe fuera conocido.

incorrect.text: Invoicing the balance of a job at a final price as a new standard invoice with no link to the provisional one.

correct.text: Issuing an R1 PARTIAL corrective against the provisional invoice for the difference.

rules.title: Discounts and rebates granted after the sale go on a corrective
rules.statement: A discount, bonus or volume rebate granted after the operation reduces the base through a corrective invoice (R1), not through a negative standard invoice.
rules.why: The reduction changes the taxable base of an invoice already issued, which only a corrective can do; a negative standard invoice is not a corrective.

applies_to.scope: rectification_code R1.

legal_basis.quote: Los descuentos y bonificaciones otorgados con posterioridad al momento en que la operación se haya realizado siempre que sean debidamente justificados.

legal_basis.norm: AEAT, Aclaraciones a dudas de los desarrolladores (v1.3)
legal_basis.quote: Los rappels se documentan en facturas rectificativas.

decision.when: You grant a discount or a volume rebate after the invoice was issued.
decision.then: Issue an R1 PARTIAL corrective with the discount as a negative line.

incorrect.text: Issuing a new standard invoice with a negative line for the rebate.

correct.text: Issuing a partial corrective against the invoice the rebate applies to.

rules.title: Returns can be netted only on a later supply to the same customer
rules.statement: Document returned goods or packaging with a corrective. The law lets you net them on the invoice of a later supply instead only when it goes to the same customer and every operation carries the same VAT rate.
rules.why: Outside that exception, a return changes the base of the invoice it came from and needs a corrective against it.

legal_basis.quote: cuando la modificación de la base imponible sea consecuencia de la devolución de mercancías o de envases y embalajes que se realicen con ocasión de un posterior suministro que tenga el mismo destinatario [...] no será necesaria la expedición de una factura rectificativa, sino que se podrá practicar la rectificación en la factura que se expida por dicho suministro [...] La rectificación se podrá realizar de este modo siempre que el tipo impositivo aplicable a todas las operaciones sea el mismo, con independencia de que su resultado sea positivo o negativo.

incorrect.text: Deducting returned crates from the next invoice to a different customer.

correct.text: Issuing an R1 PARTIAL corrective against the invoice the crates were delivered with.

rules.title: A corrective is only for the causes the law lists
rules.statement: Do not issue a corrective for anything but a missing requirement, wrongly charged tax or an art. 80 LIVA change. An invoice issued in exchange for earlier simplified invoices is not a corrective.
rules.why: Only those causes make an invoice a corrective; a corrective issued for anything else misreports what happened.

legal_basis.quote: Únicamente tendrán la consideración de facturas rectificativas las que se expidan por alguna de las causas previstas en los apartados 1 y 2. No obstante, las facturas que se expidan en sustitución o canje de facturas simplificadas expedidas con anterioridad no tendrán la condición de rectificativas, siempre que las facturas simplificadas expedidas en su día cumpliesen los requisitos establecidos en el artículo 7.1.

incorrect.text: Issuing a corrective to cancel an invoice for a sale that never happened.

correct.text: Voiding that invoice, because it should never have been issued.

rules.title: A corrective keeps the operation date of the original
rules.statement: The operation date of a corrective is the date the original supply or service took place. BeeL. copies the original invoice's operation_date to the corrective.
rules.why: The corrective adjusts the tax of that operation, so AEAT expects it dated like the operation, not like the day it was issued.

legal_basis.norm: AEAT, Preguntas frecuentes SIF y VERI*FACTU
legal_basis.quote: Se incluirá como fecha de operación la fecha en que se realizó la entrega o prestó el servicio, indicada en la factura inicial. En el caso de rectificar varias facturas con una única factura rectificativa se indicará la fecha más reciente.

incorrect.text: Recording the corrective of a March delivery as an operation of the day the corrective was issued.

correct.text: Sending operation_date on the original whenever the delivery happened on a different day from its issue, so the corrective inherits it.

rules.title: Do not raise the VAT charged to a consumer through a corrective
rules.statement: Do not issue a corrective that increases the VAT charged to a recipient who is not a business, unless it follows an art. 80 LIVA cause or a legal rise of the tax rate.
rules.why: The law does not let the issuer pass its own tax error on to a consumer after the sale.

applies_to.scope: Recipient who is not a business.

legal_basis.quote: Cuando la rectificación no esté motivada por las causas previstas en el artículo 80 de esta Ley, implique un aumento de las cuotas repercutidas y los destinatarios de las operaciones no actúen como empresarios o profesionales, salvo en supuestos de elevación legal de los tipos impositivos

incorrect.text: Charging a consumer, through an R5 corrective, the VAT you forgot to add to a ticket.

correct.text: Absorbing the error, or correcting it only if the rise comes from a legal change of the rate.

rules.title: The number is assigned when the invoice is issued
rules.statement: Do not expect or send an invoice number: a draft has none, and BeeL. assigns the next number of the chosen series when the invoice is issued. Read invoice_number from the response of the issue call.
rules.why: Numbering at issue is what keeps the series free of gaps: a draft deleted before issuing never consumed a number.

incorrect.text: Storing the draft's id as the invoice number in your system, or computing the next number yourself before issuing.

correct.text: Issuing the draft and saving the invoice_number the issue call returns.

rules.title: An issued number is never reused, even when the invoice is voided
rules.statement: Treat every issued number as consumed for good. A voided invoice, or a test issued in production, keeps its number in the series; the invoice that replaces it gets a new one.
rules.why: The number identifies the invoice in AEAT's records. A second invoice with the same number would be a duplicate that AEAT does not accept.

legal_basis.norm: AEAT, Preguntas frecuentes SIF y VERI*FACTU
legal_basis.quote: Desde el punto de vista sustantivo, si las facturas se han emitido, aunque sean erróneas deben mantenerse, con su correspondiente numeración, y sin perjuicio de que se anulen posteriormente y se sustituyan por nuevas facturas correctas.

legal_basis.norm: AEAT, Aclaraciones a dudas de los desarrolladores (v1.3)
legal_basis.article: 6. Prohibición de numeración duplicada de un registro
legal_basis.quote: ya NO es posible reutilizar la numeración de ninguna factura expedida, aunque sean facturas expedidas "de prueba".

incorrect.text: Voiding invoice A-2026-0042 and trying to issue its replacement with the same number.

correct.text: Voiding A-2026-0042 and issuing the replacement as a new invoice, which takes the next number of the series.

rules.title: Numbers are correlative within each series
rules.statement: Within a series, invoice numbers follow one another without gaps or jumps. BeeL. takes the next number of the series at issue, so numbers are only correlative if every invoice of that series is issued through it.
rules.why: A gap or a jump in a series is what an inspection reads as a missing invoice.

legal_basis.quote: Número y, en su caso, serie. La numeración de las facturas dentro de cada serie será correlativa.

incorrect.text: Issuing some invoices of series A from another system while BeeL. issues the rest of the same series.

correct.text: Giving each system its own series, or continuing an old sequence in BeeL. by setting the series' initial number before its first invoice.

rules.title: Separate series may be used when there is a reason for them
rules.statement: You may number invoices in separate series when there is a reason, such as several establishments or operations of a different nature. Create one series per establishment or line of business and pick it when you create the invoice.
rules.why: Mixing establishments in one series makes the sequence hard to follow; the law lets you keep them apart.

legal_basis.quote: Se podrán expedir facturas mediante series separadas cuando existan razones que lo justifiquen y, entre otros supuestos, cuando el obligado a su expedición cuente con varios establecimientos desde los que efectúe sus operaciones y cuando el obligado a su expedición realice operaciones de distinta naturaleza.

incorrect.text: Creating a new series every month to restart the count, with no establishment or kind of operation behind it.

correct.text: Creating series SHOP and ONLINE for a business that sells in a shop and on the web, and sending each invoice's series_id.

rules.title: Simplified invoices are numbered in their own series
rules.statement: A business that issues both full and simplified invoices in the same calendar year numbers them in separate series. A typed BeeL. series accepts only its own document type, so keep one series for each type.
rules.why: Full and simplified invoices sharing a series would leave neither sequence correlative.

legal_basis.quote: Cuando el empresario o profesional expida facturas conforme a este artículo y al artículo 6 para la documentación de las operaciones efectuadas en un mismo año natural, será obligatoria la expedición mediante series separadas de unas y otras.

incorrect.text: Creating a SIMPLIFIED invoice with the series_id of your standard-invoice series: it is rejected with SERIES_DOCUMENT_TYPE_INCOMPATIBLE.

correct.text: Omitting series_id, so the default series for simplified invoices is used, or passing a series created for that type.

rules.title: Corrective invoices are numbered in their own series
rules.statement: Corrective invoices go in a series specific to correctives, never in the series of ordinary invoices. Without a series_id, BeeL. numbers a corrective in the default corrective series; a typed series of another type is rejected.
rules.why: The law requires correctives to be told apart from ordinary invoices by their series.

legal_basis.quote: No obstante, será obligatoria, en todo caso, la expedición en series específicas de las facturas siguientes: [...] 2.º Las rectificativas.

incorrect.text: Passing the series_id of your ordinary series when creating a corrective invoice.

correct.text: Omitting series_id on the corrective, so the default corrective series numbers it.
correct.code:
POST /v1/companies/{company_id}/invoices/{invoice_id}/corrective

{ "rectification_type": "TOTAL", "rectification_code": "R1", "reason": "Invoice issued with the wrong VAT rate" }

rules.title: A series cannot be renumbered once it has issued
rules.statement: Once a series has issued an invoice, its code, format, reset policy and initial number are fixed. Design the series before its first invoice; to number differently, create a new series.
rules.why: Changing how an issued series is numbered would rewrite numbers already registered with AEAT or break the sequence.

incorrect.text: Changing the format of series A after it has issued invoices, to add the year: it is rejected with SERIES_NUMBERING_FROZEN.

correct.text: Creating a new series with the new format and making it the default for new invoices.

rules.title: An invoice number fits AEAT's length and character set
rules.statement: The full invoice number, series prefix included, is at most 60 characters and uses only printable ASCII characters, without double quotes, single quotes, less-than, greater-than or equals signs. Choose series codes and formats that keep every number within these limits.
rules.why: AEAT identifies the invoice by this number, in the record and in the QR. A number outside these limits is rejected by AEAT after the invoice has been issued and numbered.

applies_to.scope: VeriFactu enabled.

legal_basis.quote: NumSerieFactura solo puede contener caracteres ASCII del 32 a 126 (caracteres imprimibles), no permitiéndose la existencia de los siguientes caracteres:

legal_basis.norm: AEAT, Detalle de las especificaciones técnicas del código QR de la factura (v0.5.0)
legal_basis.quote: numserie Cadena de Máximo 60 Sí Nº Serie + Nº Factura

incorrect.text: A series format that produces numbers like SHOP=2026/"0001", with characters AEAT does not accept.

correct.text: A series format that produces short numbers such as SHOP-2026-0001.

rules.title: Reverse-charge supplies of metals and electronics go in a special series
rules.statement: Invoices for supplies of silver, platinum, palladium, mobile phones, game consoles, laptops or tablets in which the buyer is liable for the VAT are issued in a special series. Create a dedicated series and use it for these invoices.
rules.why: The law requires these reverse-charge supplies to be documented in their own series; mixing them with other invoices breaks that requirement.

applies_to.scope: Supplies of silver, platinum, palladium, mobile phones, game consoles, laptops or tablets where the buyer is liable for VAT.

legal_basis.quote: Las entregas de dichos bienes, en los casos en que sean sujetos pasivos del Impuesto sus destinatarios conforme a lo establecido en este número 2.°, deberán documentarse en una factura mediante serie especial.
4.º Las que se expidan conforme a lo previsto en el artículo 84, apartado uno, número 2.º, letra g), de la Ley 37/1992, de 28 de diciembre, del Impuesto sobre el Valor Añadido.

incorrect.text: Invoicing a batch of laptops to a reseller in the same series as the rest of your sales.

correct.text: Creating a series such as ISP-G and issuing those invoices in it.

rules.title: Every operation of the business is invoiced, exempt ones included
rules.statement: Issue an invoice, full or simplified, for every supply of goods or services the business makes, including operations that are not subject to VAT or are exempt, except where the invoicing regulation says one is not needed.
rules.why: A missing invoice is a breach of the invoicing obligation in itself, whatever tax it would have carried.

applies_to.scope: Every supply of goods or services made in the course of business.

legal_basis.quote: los empresarios o profesionales están obligados a expedir factura y copia de esta por las entregas de bienes y prestaciones de servicios que realicen en el desarrollo de su actividad, incluidas las no sujetas y las sujetas pero exentas del Impuesto

incorrect.text: Leaving a course taught to a customer out of the books because it is exempt from VAT.

correct.text: Invoicing the course with a line classified as exempt, so the invoice states the exemption.

rules.title: A business customer always gets an invoice
rules.statement: When the recipient is a business or professional acting as such, or asks for an invoice to exercise a tax right, issue a full invoice that identifies them. A receipt or ticket is not enough.
rules.why: Without an invoice the customer cannot deduct the VAT, and the issuer breaches its invoicing obligation.

applies_to.scope: The recipient is a business or professional acting as such, or asks for an invoice to exercise a tax right.

legal_basis.quote: Aquellas en las que el destinatario sea un empresario o profesional que actúe como tal, con independencia del régimen de tributación al que se encuentre acogido el empresario o profesional que realice la operación, así como cualesquiera otras en las que el destinatario así lo exija para el ejercicio de cualquier derecho de naturaleza tributaria.

incorrect.text: Selling to a company at the counter and handing over only a simplified invoice without its NIF.

correct.text: Issuing a STANDARD invoice with the company's legal name, NIF and address.

rules.title: A full invoice names both parties by their legal name
rules.statement: A full invoice shows the full name or legal name of the issuer and of the recipient. Send the recipient's legal_name, not a trade name; BeeL. takes the issuer's from the company's tax profile and does not issue while that profile is incomplete.
rules.why: The legal name is what identifies each party for tax purposes; a trade name alone does not.

legal_basis.quote: Nombre y apellidos, razón o denominación social completa, tanto del obligado a expedir factura como del destinatario de las operaciones.

incorrect.text: Sending only the shop name the customer trades under.

correct.text: Sending the legal name as registered, with the trade name as an extra.

rules.title: Every invoice shows the issuer's NIF
rules.statement: Every invoice carries the NIF the issuer operates with. BeeL. uses the NIF of the issuing company and does not submit an invoice to VeriFactu while the company has none.
rules.why: The issuer's NIF is what AEAT files the invoice and its record under.

legal_basis.quote: Número de Identificación Fiscal atribuido por la Administración tributaria española o, en su caso, por la de otro Estado miembro de la Unión Europea, con el que ha realizado la operación el obligado a expedir la factura.

incorrect.text: Issuing invoices for a company whose NIF was never set in its profile.

correct.text: Completing the company's NIF before its first invoice; each NIF issues through its own company.

rules.title: A full invoice identifies the recipient by NIF
rules.statement: Send the recipient's NIF, or an alternative identifier for a customer without a Spanish NIF, on every standard invoice. The NIF is mandatory by law for exempt intra-EU supplies of goods, reverse-charge operations and operations located in Spain by an issuer established here.
rules.why: Without the recipient's identification the invoice does not meet the legal content, and the customer cannot deduct its VAT.

legal_basis.quote: Asimismo, será obligatoria la consignación del Número de Identificación Fiscal del destinatario en los siguientes casos: 1.º Que se trate de una entrega de bienes destinados a otro Estado miembro que se encuentre exenta conforme al artículo 25 de la Ley del Impuesto. 2.º Que se trate de una operación cuyo destinatario sea el sujeto pasivo del Impuesto correspondiente a aquélla. 3.º Que se trate de operaciones que se entiendan realizadas en el territorio de aplicación del Impuesto y el empresario o profesional obligado a la expedición de la factura haya de considerarse establecido en dicho territorio.

incorrect.text: Creating a standard invoice for a Spanish company with only its name and address: it is rejected with RECIPIENT_ID_REQUIRED.

correct.text: Sending the company's NIF with its legal name and address.

rules.title: A full invoice shows the address of both parties
rules.statement: A full invoice shows the address of the issuer and of the recipient. Send the recipient's fiscal address, also on customers you store; BeeL. rejects an invoice without one only when the recipient is sent inline.
rules.why: The address is part of the legal content of a full invoice; an invoice without the recipient's address is incomplete and has to be corrected.

legal_basis.quote: Domicilio, tanto del obligado a expedir factura como del destinatario de las operaciones.

incorrect.text: Invoicing a stored customer imported without an address.

correct.text: Completing the customer's address before invoicing it, or sending the recipient inline with its address.

rules.title: Each line describes the operation, its unit price and any discount
rules.statement: Describe each operation with the data needed to work out its taxable base: a meaningful description, the unit price without tax, and any discount not already included in that price. Send the discount as discount_percentage rather than folding it into the price.
rules.why: A line that does not say what was supplied or at what price does not let anyone check the taxable base.

legal_basis.quote: Descripción de las operaciones, consignándose todos los datos necesarios para la determinación de la base imponible del Impuesto, tal y como ésta se define por los artículos 78 y 79 de la Ley del Impuesto, correspondiente a aquéllas y su importe, incluyendo el precio unitario sin Impuesto de dichas operaciones, así como cualquier descuento o rebaja que no esté incluido en dicho precio unitario.

incorrect.text: A single line described as Services with the discount already subtracted from the price.

correct.text: A line that says what was supplied, with its net unit price and the discount apart.

rules.title: The tax rate and the tax amount are shown apart from the base
rules.statement: A full invoice states the tax rate applied and the tax amount charged, separately from the taxable base. You choose the rate of each line; BeeL. computes the tax amount of each rate and shows it apart from the base.
rules.why: The VAT charged is what the customer deducts; it has to be readable on its own, next to the rate it comes from.

legal_basis.quote: El tipo impositivo o tipos impositivos, en su caso, aplicados a las operaciones. h) La cuota tributaria que, en su caso, se repercuta, que deberá consignarse por separado.
A estos efectos, la cuota repercutida se consignará separadamente de la base imponible, incluso en el caso de precios fijados administrativamente, indicando el tipo impositivo aplicado.

incorrect.text: Sending a line with a price that already includes VAT as if it were the net price, so the base and the tax amount on the invoice are wrong.

correct.text: Sending the net price with its main_tax, or pricing the line with total_including_tax so BeeL. works the base and the tax out of the total.

rules.title: The base is broken down by rate and by kind of operation
rules.statement: When one invoice mixes exempt and taxed operations, reverse-charge and ordinary operations, or different VAT rates, the taxable base is shown separately for each. Classify every line on its own; BeeL. groups the breakdown from those classifications.
rules.why: Each part of the base is taxed differently; lumped together, the invoice does not say how much is exempt or at which rate.

legal_basis.quote: Deberá especificarse por separado la parte de base imponible correspondiente a cada una de las operaciones que se documenten en una misma factura en los siguientes casos:

incorrect.text: Putting an exempt training course and taxed materials on one line at 21 %.

correct.text: Two lines: the course classified as exempt and the materials at 21 %, each with its own main_tax.

rules.title: An exempt operation states why it is exempt
rules.statement: An invoice for an exempt operation refers to the article of the VAT law or of Directive 2006/112/CE that exempts it, or states that it is exempt. Give every 0 % line its exemption_reason, and an exemption_reason_text when the reason is OTRO.
rules.why: Without the reference, a 0 % line reads as a missing tax, not as an exemption.

legal_basis.quote: En el supuesto de que la operación que se documenta en una factura esté exenta del Impuesto, una referencia a las disposiciones correspondientes de la Directiva 2006/112/CE, de 28 de noviembre, relativa al sistema común del Impuesto sobre el Valor Añadido, o a los preceptos correspondientes de la Ley del Impuesto o indicación de que la operación está exenta.

incorrect.text: A line at 0 % with no exemption reason: it is rejected with EXEMPT_ZERO_RATE_REQUIRES_REASON.

correct.text: An educational service exempt under article 20 of the VAT law.

rules.title: Only one original of each invoice exists
rules.statement: Issue a single original of each invoice. A duplicate is allowed only when the same operation has several recipients or the original was lost, and every duplicate carries the word «duplicado».
rules.why: Two originals of one invoice look like two operations to the customer and to an inspection.

applies_to.scope: Copies handed over after issue.

legal_basis.quote: 1. Los empresarios y profesionales o sujetos pasivos sólo podrán expedir un original de cada factura. [...] 4. En cada uno de los ejemplares duplicados deberá hacerse constar la expresión «duplicado».

incorrect.text: Issuing the same sale again as a new invoice because the customer lost the first one.

correct.text: Sending the customer the PDF of the original again, marked «duplicado» if you hand it over as a duplicate.

rules.title: A reverse-charge invoice carries the mention «inversión del sujeto pasivo»
rules.statement: When the recipient is the one liable for the VAT, the invoice carries the mention «inversión del sujeto pasivo». Classify those lines as reverse charge, and print the mention on any document you render yourself.
rules.why: The mention is what tells the recipient that it has to self-assess the VAT; without it the invoice reads as if VAT had been left out by mistake.

applies_to.scope: Operations in which the recipient is liable for the VAT (reverse charge).

legal_basis.quote: En el caso de que el sujeto pasivo del Impuesto sea el adquirente o el destinatario de la operación, la mención «inversión del sujeto pasivo».

incorrect.text: Invoicing construction work for a developer at 0 % VAT with no mention of who pays the tax.

correct.text: Classifying the line as reverse charge, so the invoice states «inversión del sujeto pasivo».

rules.title: A cash-basis invoice carries the mention «régimen especial del criterio de caja»
rules.statement: Invoices for operations under the special cash-basis regime carry the mention «régimen especial del criterio de caja». Make sure it appears on the invoice, and print it on any document you render yourself.
rules.why: The mention tells the recipient that the VAT accrues on payment, which changes when it can deduct it.

applies_to.scope: Operations under the special cash-basis VAT regime (regime key 07).

legal_basis.quote: En el caso de aplicación del régimen especial del criterio de caja la mención «régimen especial del criterio de caja.

incorrect.text: Sending regime key 07 and handing over an invoice that says nothing about the cash-basis regime.

correct.text: Sending regime key 07 and making sure the invoice carries the mention, for example in its notes.

rules.title: A used-goods, art or antiques invoice carries its regime mention
rules.statement: Invoices under the special regime for used goods, works of art, antiques and collectors' items carry the corresponding regime mention, and do not show the VAT separately. Make sure both hold on the invoice you hand over.
rules.why: Under this regime the VAT is charged on the margin; showing it apart, or omitting the mention, misstates the tax to the buyer.

applies_to.scope: Operations under the special regime for used goods, works of art, antiques and collectors' items (regime key 03).

legal_basis.quote: En caso de aplicación del régimen especial de los bienes usados, objetos de arte, antigüedades y objetos de colección, la mención «régimen especial de los bienes usados», «régimen especial de los objetos de arte» o «régimen especial de las antigüedades y objetos de colección».

incorrect.text: Selling a second-hand car under the margin regime with the VAT broken out on the invoice.

correct.text: Invoicing it under regime key 03 with the mention «régimen especial de los bienes usados» and the VAT included in the price.

rules.title: A travel-agency invoice carries the mention «régimen especial de las agencias de viajes»
rules.statement: Invoices under the special regime for travel agencies carry the mention «régimen especial de las agencias de viajes». Make sure it appears on the invoice you hand over.
rules.why: The mention tells the customer that the VAT is charged on the agency's margin, not on the full price.

applies_to.scope: Operations under the special regime for travel agencies.

legal_basis.quote: En caso de aplicación del régimen especial de las agencias de viajes, la mención «régimen especial de las agencias de viajes».

incorrect.text: Invoicing a package holiday under the travel-agency regime with no mention of the regime.

correct.text: Invoicing it with the mention «régimen especial de las agencias de viajes» on the invoice.

rules.title: An intra-EU supply of a new means of transport describes the vehicle
rules.statement: An invoice for the intra-EU supply of a new means of transport states its characteristics, the date it first entered service, and the distance or hours travelled until delivery. Put these in the line description.
rules.why: These data are what make the vehicle count as new, which decides where its VAT is paid.

applies_to.scope: Supplies of new means of transport to another EU Member State.

legal_basis.quote: En las entregas de medios de transporte nuevos a que se refiere el artículo 25 de la Ley del Impuesto, sus características, la fecha de su primera puesta en servicio y las distancias recorridas u horas de navegación o vuelo realizadas hasta su entrega.

incorrect.text: A line that says only Motorbike.

correct.text: A line that says Motorbike, 125 cc, first registered 2026-08-01, 150 km at delivery.

rules.title: An invoice may be in any language
rules.statement: You may issue an invoice in any language. Keep the means to produce a Spanish version, because AEAT may ask for a translation of an invoice in a language that is not official in Spain.
rules.why: An invoice AEAT cannot read in an inspection has to be translated at the issuer's expense.

applies_to.scope: The language of the invoice document.

legal_basis.quote: Las facturas podrán expedirse en cualquier lengua. No obstante, la Administración tributaria, cuando lo considere necesario [...] podrá exigir una traducción al castellano, o a otra lengua oficial en España, de las facturas expedidas en una lengua no oficial

incorrect.text: Assuming an English-only invoice can never be asked for in Spanish.

correct.text: Issuing in English for a foreign customer, knowing the PDF can also be produced in Spanish.

rules.title: Invoices go by email only with the recipient's consent
rules.statement: Send invoices electronically only to recipients who have agreed to receive them that way, except where electronic invoicing is mandatory. Record that consent in your own system before emailing invoices.
rules.why: An electronic invoice sent without consent does not count as delivered in the form the law allows.

applies_to.scope: Electronic delivery of invoices.

legal_basis.quote: La expedición, transmisión y recepción de la factura electrónica estará condicionada a que su destinatario haya dado su consentimiento, excepto en los supuestos de factura electrónica obligatoria establecidos en el artículo 8 bis.

incorrect.text: Emailing invoices to every customer on file without having asked them.

correct.text: Asking at sign-up whether the customer accepts invoices by email, and emailing only those who do.

rules.title: An invoice never totals zero, and only a corrective totals less
rules.statement: Do not create an invoice whose lines add up to zero, and do not use a standard or simplified invoice with a negative total as a credit note. A refund or a reduction is a corrective invoice against the original.
rules.why: An invoice of zero documents nothing, and a negative ordinary invoice is a correction without the link to the invoice it corrects.

incorrect.text: Creating a STANDARD invoice with a single line of -100 to refund a customer: it is rejected with NEGATIVE_TOTAL_REQUIRES_RECTIFICATIVE.

correct.text: Issuing a partial corrective against the invoice being refunded.
correct.code:
POST /v1/companies/{company_id}/invoices/{invoice_id}/corrective

{ "rectification_type": "PARTIAL", "rectification_code": "R1", "reason": "Refund of one unit returned by the customer", "lines": [{ "description": "Returned unit", "quantity": -1, "unit_price": 100 }] }

rules.title: A Spanish recipient's NIF is in the AEAT census
rules.statement: Check a Spanish customer's NIF against the AEAT census before invoicing it. With VeriFactu enabled, BeeL. refuses to issue to a NIF that AEAT reports as not in the census or revoked, before any number is spent.
rules.why: AEAT accepts a record whose recipient is not in the census only as an error that has to be fixed later; a revoked NIF cannot operate at all.

applies_to.scope: VeriFactu enabled.

legal_basis.article: 4.3.1 Tratamiento de los errores en remisión voluntaria VERI*FACTU
legal_basis.quote: Los registros de facturación con errores admisibles serán “aceptados” y registrados por los sistemas de la AEAT, pero deberán ser subsanados para poder llevar a cabo el tratamiento y validación de los mismos. [...] Los NIF informados en la agrupación Destinatario que sean correctos, pero no figuren censados en la AEAT, indicando el tipo de identificación “07” (“No censado”) en el campo “IDType” dentro del bloque “IDOtro”.

incorrect.text: Issuing to a customer whose NIF and legal name do not match the census: it is rejected with NIF_NOT_IN_CENSUS.

correct.text: Validating the NIF when the customer signs up, and correcting the legal name or NIF before the first invoice.

rules.title: A recipient without a Spanish NIF is identified by an alternative id
rules.statement: Identify a recipient without a Spanish NIF with an alternative_id of the type that fits (EU VAT number, passport, official ID, residence certificate, other document or not registered) and its country, never together with a nif. With country ES, only a passport or the not-registered type is accepted.
rules.why: AEAT identifies each recipient either by NIF or by this identifier, never both, and rejects combinations its validations do not allow.

legal_basis.quote: Si se cumplimenta NIF, no deberá existir la agrupación IDOtro y viceversa, pero es obligatorio que se cumplimente uno de los dos.
Cuando uno o varios destinatarios se identifiquen a través de la agrupación IDOtro y CodigoPais sea "ES", se validará que el campo IDType sea “03” o “07”.
02 NIF-IVA. 03 Pasaporte. 04 Documento oficial de identificación expedido por el país o territorio de residencia. 05 Certificado de residencia. 06 Otro documento probatorio. 07 No censado.

incorrect.text: Sending a French company's VAT number in nif together with an alternative_id: it is rejected with RECIPIENT_NIF_AND_ID_OTHER_EXCLUSIVE.

correct.text: Sending only the alternative identifier, with its type and country.

rules.title: A simplified invoice never exceeds 3,000 €
rules.statement: Do not issue a simplified invoice whose total, VAT included, is above 3,000 €, whatever the activity. Above it, issue a standard invoice (F1) with the customer identified.
rules.why: The law allows a simplified invoice up to that amount only for the activities of art. 4.2, and AEAT rejects an F2 record above it.

legal_basis.quote: los empresarios o profesionales podrán igualmente expedir factura simplificada y copia de ésta cuando su importe no exceda de 3.000 euros, Impuesto sobre el Valor Añadido incluido, en las operaciones que se describen a continuación: a) Ventas al por menor
Cuando TipoFactura sea “F2”, se validará que Ʃ (BaseImponibleOimporteNoSujeto + CuotaRepercutida) de todas las líneas de detalle no sea superior a 3.000,00 euros.

incorrect.text: A simplified invoice with one line of 2,600 € at 21 % VAT: it totals 3,146 € and the API answers SIMPLIFIED_INVOICE_EXCEEDS_LEGAL_LIMIT.

correct.text: The same sale as a standard invoice, with the customer's NIF or alternative_id.

rules.title: Above 400 €, a simplified invoice needs an art. 4.2 activity
rules.statement: Do not issue a simplified invoice above 400 €, VAT included, unless the operation is one of those listed in art. 4.2 (retail sales, hospitality, passenger transport and the rest of the list) or the invoice is a corrective.
rules.why: Outside art. 4.2 the law only allows a simplified invoice up to that amount; above it the operation needed a full invoice.

legal_basis.quote: La obligación de expedir factura podrá ser cumplida mediante la expedición de factura simplificada y copia de esta en cualquiera de los siguientes supuestos: a) Cuando su importe no exceda de 400 euros, Impuesto sobre el Valor Añadido incluido, o b) cuando deba expedirse una factura rectificativa.

incorrect.text: A consultancy issuing a 900 € simplified invoice to a private client.

correct.text: A restaurant issuing a 900 € simplified invoice for a group dinner: hospitality is in the art. 4.2 list.

rules.title: Some operations can never go on a simplified invoice
rules.statement: Do not document on a simplified invoice the operations of art. 4.4, such as intra-EU supplies of goods exempt under art. 25 LIVA. The API rejects intra-EU and OSS operations and reverse charge on a simplified invoice and, as BeeL.'s own rule, also equivalence surcharge and IRPF withholding.
rules.why: These operations need an identified recipient, whether to exempt, to shift the tax to the customer or to withhold, and a simplified invoice has none.

legal_basis.quote: No podrá expedirse factura simplificada por las siguientes operaciones: a) Las entregas de bienes destinados a otro Estado miembro a que se refiere el artículo 25 de la Ley del Impuesto.

incorrect.text: A simplified invoice for goods shipped to a company in France under the intra-EU exemption: the API answers SIMPLIFICADA_FORBIDS_CROSS_BORDER.

correct.text: A standard invoice identifying the French company by its VAT number.

rules.title: A simplified invoice still carries its minimum contents
rules.statement: A simplified invoice carries its number and series, issue date, the operation date when different, the issuer's NIF and name, what was sold, the tax rate and the total. BeeL. fills in the issuer's data from the company profile; each line needs a description and its main tax.
rules.why: Simplified does not mean empty: without these details the ticket is not a valid invoice.

legal_basis.quote: d) Número de Identificación Fiscal, así como el nombre y apellidos, razón o denominación social completa del obligado a su expedición. e) La identificación del tipo de bienes entregados o de servicios prestados. f) Tipo impositivo aplicado y, opcionalmente, también la expresión «IVA incluido». [...] g) Contraprestación total.

incorrect.text: A simplified invoice whose only line has no description: the API answers LINE_NORMAL_DESCRIPTION_REQUIRED.

correct.text: The same line with a description of what was sold and its VAT rate.

rules.title: The record of a simplified invoice carries no recipient
rules.statement: The billing record of a simplified invoice (F2) or of its corrective (R5) carries no recipient, while F1 and R1–R4 records carry at least one. BeeL. never sends recipient data in an F2 or R5 record.
rules.why: AEAT rejects an F2 or R5 record with recipients, and an F1 without them.

applies_to.scope: VeriFactu enabled; F2 and R5 records.

legal_basis.quote: Si TipoFactura es “F1”, “F3”, “R1”, “R2”, “R3” o “R4”, la agrupación Destinatarios tiene que estar cumplimentada, con al menos un destinatario. - Si TipoFactura es “F2” o “R5”, la agrupación Destinatarios no puede estar cumplimentada.

incorrect.text: Expecting the customer's name on a simplified invoice to reach AEAT.

correct.text: Issuing a standard invoice when the customer has to be identified to AEAT.

rules.title: An identified customer gets a standard invoice (F1)
rules.statement: When a business customer asks for its NIF and address on the invoice, or a consumer needs them to exercise a tax right, the invoice identifies the recipient and shows the tax separately, and AEAT registers it as F1. In BeeL. issue it as a standard invoice: a simplified invoice takes no identified recipient.
rules.why: A simplified invoice that identifies its recipient is a qualified one, registered as F1; an F2 record cannot carry the recipient.

legal_basis.quote: cuando el destinatario de la operación sea un empresario o profesional y así lo exija, el expedidor de la factura simplificada deberá hacer constar, además, los siguientes datos: a) Número de Identificación Fiscal [...] así como el domicilio del destinatario de las operaciones. b) La cuota tributaria que, en su caso, se repercuta, que deberá consignarse por separado.

legal_basis.norm: AEAT, Preguntas frecuentes SIF y VERI*FACTU
legal_basis.article: Procedimientos de facturación: Tipo de facturas
legal_basis.quote: Se registran con la clave F1: [...] Las facturas simplificadas cualificadas reguladas en los artículos 7.2 y 7.3 del Reglamento por el que se regulan las obligaciones de facturación, caracterizadas porque se identifica al destinatario de las mismas.

incorrect.text: A simplified invoice whose recipient carries the customer's nif: the API answers SIMPLIFIED_INVOICE_FORBIDS_IDENTIFIED_RECIPIENT.

correct.text: A standard invoice with the customer's NIF, name and address, whatever the amount.

rules.title: Exchanging a simplified invoice for a full one
rules.statement: An invoice issued in exchange for earlier simplified invoices is not a corrective. AEAT registers it as F3, identifying the invoices it replaces, or as F1 when the simplified invoice was first credited. BeeL. issues the full invoice as a standard invoice (F1) after an R5 TOTAL corrective on the simplified one.
rules.why: The exchange documents the same sale again with the customer identified; the simplified invoice has to be offset so the sale is not counted twice.

legal_basis.quote: No obstante, las facturas que se expidan en sustitución o canje de facturas simplificadas expedidas con anterioridad no tendrán la condición de rectificativas, siempre que las facturas simplificadas expedidas en su día cumpliesen los requisitos establecidos en el artículo 7.1.

legal_basis.norm: AEAT, Preguntas frecuentes SIF y VERI*FACTU
legal_basis.article: Procedimientos de facturación: factura en sustitución de simplificadas
legal_basis.quote: Se deberá informar en el bloque “Tipo Factura” con la clave “F3: factura emitida en sustitución de facturas simplificadas facturadas y declaradas” [...] IMPORTANTE: En el caso de que se realice un abono de la factura simplificada (mediante el envío de un registro negativo con clave “F2”), la factura emitida en sustitución de esta tendrá que informarse con la clave “F1”.

decision.when: The customer asks for a full invoice with their details in place of a simplified one already issued.
decision.then: Issue an R5 TOTAL corrective on the simplified invoice, then a new standard invoice with the customer's data.

incorrect.text: Issuing a standard invoice for the same sale and leaving the simplified invoice as it was: the sale is invoiced twice.

correct.text: Cancelling the simplified invoice with an R5 TOTAL corrective, then issuing the standard invoice.
correct.code: { "rectification_type": "TOTAL", "rectification_code": "R5", "reason": "Customer asked for an invoice with its details" }

rules.title: A simplified invoice carries the same legal mentions as a full one
rules.statement: When they apply, a simplified invoice carries the same mentions as a full invoice: the exemption, the special regime or the other mentions of art. 6.1 j) to p).
rules.why: The mention is what tells the reader why the invoice charges no tax or follows a special regime; a ticket is not exempt from it.

legal_basis.quote: En los supuestos a que se refieren las letras j) a p) del artículo 6.1 de este Reglamento, deberá hacerse constar las menciones referidas en las mismas.

incorrect.text: A ticket for an exempt service that states neither the exemption nor its legal basis.

correct.text: The same ticket with the line's exemption reason, so the invoice cites the exempting article.

rules.title: A customer who needs a full invoice is entitled to one
rules.statement: When the recipient is a business acting as such, or asks for an invoice to exercise a tax right, issue a full invoice with its details, even if you would otherwise hand out a simplified one.
rules.why: The law obliges the issuer to invoice in these cases; a ticket without the customer's details does not let it deduct the tax.

legal_basis.quote: Aquellas en las que el destinatario sea un empresario o profesional que actúe como tal, con independencia del régimen de tributación al que se encuentre acogido el empresario o profesional que realice la operación, así como cualesquiera otras en las que el destinatario así lo exija para el ejercicio de cualquier derecho de naturaleza tributaria.

incorrect.text: Refusing a company its own invoice because the till only prints tickets.

correct.text: Issuing a standard invoice with the company's NIF and address, or exchanging the ticket for one.

rules.title: Apply the VAT rate in force when the operation took place
rules.statement: Each taxed line carries the VAT rate that applied on the date the operation accrued, not the one in force on the day you issue. The rate must also be one AEAT accepts for a subject, non-exempt line.
rules.why: A rate that was not in force at accrual charges the wrong tax, and AEAT checks the rate against the operation date: the record is rejected or the invoice has to be corrected.

applies_to.scope: Lines taxed with IVA (main_tax.type: IVA).

legal_basis.quote: Dos. El tipo impositivo aplicable a cada operación será el vigente en el momento del devengo.
Solo se permiten TipoImpositivo = 0; 2; 4; 5; 7,5; 10 y 21 (valores que indican el tanto por ciento).

incorrect.text: Invoicing in October a supply that accrued in June at the rate that applies in October, because it is the one in force on the issue date.

correct.text: Sending operation_date with the June date and the rate that applied in June on each line.

rules.title: Reverse-charge operations are invoiced without charging VAT
rules.statement: When the recipient is the one liable for the VAT, as in the cases of art. 84.Uno.2.º LIVA, the line does not charge VAT: classify it as reverse charge with the exemption_reason of its case. Deciding that an operation falls under reverse charge is the issuer's call.
rules.why: Charging VAT on a reverse-charge operation makes both parties declare it: the issuer collects a tax it does not owe and the recipient self-assesses it again.

applies_to.scope: Operations where the recipient is the taxpayer (inversión del sujeto pasivo).

legal_basis.quote: Los empresarios o profesionales para quienes se realicen las operaciones sujetas al Impuesto en los supuestos que se indican a continuación: a) Cuando las mismas se efectúen por personas o entidades no establecidas en el territorio de aplicación del Impuesto.

Cuando se trate de ejecuciones de obra, con o sin aportación de materiales, así como las cesiones de personal para su realización, consecuencia de contratos directamente formalizados entre el promotor y el contratista que tengan por objeto la urbanización de terrenos o la construcción o rehabilitación de edificaciones.

incorrect.text: A contractor invoicing construction work to the developer charges 21 % VAT on the line.

correct.text: The line goes at 0 % with the reverse-charge reason of its case.

rules.title: Reverse-charge lines carry no tax and never go on a simplified invoice
rules.statement: A reverse-charge line goes at 0 % with no tax amount, and only on a full invoice or its correctives, never on a simplified one. It cannot carry an equivalence surcharge nor use the OSS regime.
rules.why: AEAT registers a reverse-charge line only with rate and tax amount at zero, and only on invoice types that identify the recipient, who is the one who self-assesses.

applies_to.scope: Lines classified as reverse charge (exemption_reason ISP_ART_84_2_*).

legal_basis.quote: Si CalificacionOperacion es “S2”, TipoFactura solo puede ser “F1”, “F3”, “R1”, “R2”, “R3” y “R4”. - Cuando CalificacionOperacion sea “S2”: ✓ TipoImpositivo = 0. [...] ✓ CuotaRepercutida = 0.

incorrect.text: A simplified invoice with a reverse-charge line: the API answers SIMPLIFICADA_FORBIDS_ISP.

correct.text: A standard invoice to the identified business recipient, with the line at 0 % and its reverse-charge reason.

rules.title: Intra-EU supplies of goods are exempt only with the buyer's EU VAT number
rules.statement: An intra-EU supply of goods is exempt only when the buyer has a VAT number from another Member State and has given it to you, and the recipient goes on the invoice with that number as an alternative identifier of type NIF-IVA. The operation must also be declared in the recapitulative statement (modelo 349), outside BeeL.
rules.why: Without a valid EU VAT number the exemption does not apply and Spanish VAT was due; AEAT also rejects an E5 record that does not identify the recipient that way.

applies_to.scope: Goods shipped to a business in another EU Member State (exemption_reason: EXENTA_ART_25).

legal_basis.quote: siempre que el adquirente sea un empresario o profesional o una persona jurídica que no actúe como tal, que disponga de un número de identificación a efectos del Impuesto sobre el Valor Añadido asignado por un Estado miembro distinto del Reino de España, que haya comunicado dicho número de identificación fiscal al vendedor.
si OperacionExenta es igual a “E5”, sólo deberá existir la agrupación IDOtro cuando se cumplimente el bloque “Destinatario”.

incorrect.text: Invoicing goods to a French company as exempt with the recipient identified only by name: the API answers EXEMPTION_REQUIRES_RECIPIENT_ID_TYPE.

correct.text: Identifying the customer with its EU VAT number as alternative_id of type NIF-IVA, after checking that the number is valid.

rules.title: Exempt and non-subject lines carry no VAT rate
rules.statement: A line with an exemption_reason goes at 0 %: it carries neither a VAT rate nor a tax amount, and no equivalence surcharge.
rules.why: AEAT does not accept a rate or a tax amount on an exempt or non-subject line; the invoice would say the operation is exempt and charge VAT at the same time.

applies_to.scope: Lines with an exemption_reason (exempt, non-subject or reverse charge).

legal_basis.quote: Si el campo OperacionExenta está cumplimentado no se pueden informar ninguno de estos campos: TipoImpositivo, CuotaRepercutida, TipoRecargoEquivalencia y CuotaRecargoEquivalencia.

incorrect.text: A training course marked EXENTA_ART_20 sent at 21 %: the API answers LINE_EXEMPTION_WITH_TAX.

correct.text: The same line at 0 % with its exemption reason.

rules.title: Services to a business abroad are not subject to Spanish VAT
rules.statement: A service to a business established in another country is, as a general rule, located where the customer is established: invoice it without Spanish VAT, as not subject by location rules (NO_SUJETA_LOCALIZACION), and identify the customer. The exceptions of art. 70 LIVA (real estate, events, transport and others) need their own analysis.
rules.why: Charging Spanish VAT on a service located abroad collects a tax Spain is not owed, and the customer cannot deduct it.

applies_to.scope: Services to a business customer established outside Spain, general rule.

legal_basis.quote: Cuando el destinatario sea un empresario o profesional que actúe como tal y radique en el citado territorio la sede de su actividad económica, o tenga en el mismo un establecimiento permanente o, en su defecto, el lugar de su domicilio o residencia habitual

incorrect.text: A software consultancy invoices a German company at 21 % Spanish VAT.

correct.text: The line goes at 0 % with exemption_reason: NO_SUJETA_LOCALIZACION and the customer is identified with its EU VAT number.

rules.title: Sales declared through OSS use regime key 17
rules.statement: An operation you declare through the OSS or IOSS one-stop shop goes with regime key 17, classified as not subject by location rules. Whether your sales are above the OSS threshold of 10,000 € a year, and so under OSS, is yours to decide.
rules.why: AEAT identifies one-stop-shop sales by the regime key; under another key the record says Spanish VAT was charged on a sale taxed in another country.

applies_to.scope: Distance sales and B2C services to other EU countries declared in the OSS or IOSS one-stop shop.

legal_basis.norm: AEAT, Preguntas frecuentes SIF y VERI*FACTU
legal_basis.quote: En las operaciones de los regímenes de ventanilla única (OSS, one stop shop) [...] el código de régimen a indicar de la lista L8 es el "17": Operación acogida a alguno de los regímenes previstos en el Capítulo XI del Título IX (OSS e IOSS).

incorrect.text: An online shop above the OSS threshold invoices a consumer in Italy at 21 % under the general regime 01.

correct.text: The line goes with regime key 17, the Italian VAT rate and exemption_reason: NO_SUJETA_LOCALIZACION.

rules.title: Disbursements go as suplido lines, without tax
rules.statement: An amount you paid in the customer's name and on their behalf is not part of your taxable base: send it as a SUPLIDO line, which carries no VAT, surcharge or IRPF.
rules.why: Taxing a disbursement charges VAT on money that was never your income; AEAT only accepts it in the total as a non-subject or zero-rated amount.

applies_to.scope: Amounts paid on behalf of the customer (suplidos).

legal_basis.norm: AEAT, Preguntas frecuentes SIF y VERI*FACTU
legal_basis.quote: los importes suplidos al igual que ocurre con el recargo financiero, no son importes "propios" del registro de facturación, y no tienen que incluirse entre las menciones del “registro de facturación de alta”. No obstante, en el caso de que se incluyeran como mayor importe en el concepto “Importe total factura” (lo cual, no es obligatorio), deberán consignarse como importe no sujeto al IVA o cantidades a tipo cero (0%).

incorrect.text: A gestoría adds the registry fee it paid for the client as a normal line at 21 %.

correct.text: The fee goes as a suplido line.

rules.title: IRPF withholding is not part of the total AEAT receives
rules.statement: The IRPF withheld on an invoice is not part of its billing record: the total AEAT receives is the total before the withholding, so it can differ from the amount payable. BeeL. leaves the withholding out of the record for you.
rules.why: Comparing the QR amount or the registered total with the amount payable and reading the difference as an error leads to correcting an invoice that is right.

applies_to.scope: Invoices with IRPF withholding, under VeriFactu.

legal_basis.norm: AEAT, Preguntas frecuentes SIF y VERI*FACTU
legal_basis.quote: Por lo que se refiere a las retenciones, estas no forman parte formalmente del registro de facturación (no es uno de los elementos constitutivos de la factura de acuerdo con la Directiva UE).

incorrect.text: Flagging as a mismatch an invoice whose QR says 121.00 while the customer pays 106.00 after a 15 % withholding.

correct.text: Reconciling payments against the amount payable, and the AEAT record against the total before withholding.

rules.title: Set the IRPF withholding when the customer must withhold
rules.statement: When your customer has to withhold IRPF from your invoice, set irpf_rate on each line, one of 0, 1, 2, 7, 15, 19 or 24. BeeL. shows the withholding and takes it off the amount payable; a simplified invoice never carries it.
rules.why: Without the withholding on the invoice the customer pays the full amount, and one of you ends up correcting it with the tax authority.

applies_to.scope: Professionals invoicing a business or professional that has to withhold IRPF.

incorrect.text: A freelance consultant invoices a company without irpf_rate, and the company has to ask for a corrected invoice.

correct.text: The line carries the withholding.

rules.title: Cash-basis lines stay domestic, subject and not reverse charge
rules.statement: A line under the cash-basis regime (07) cannot be reverse charge nor non-subject, and cannot use the exemptions of articles 21 to 25 LIVA (exports and intra-EU supplies).
rules.why: AEAT rejects the record, and with BeeL. that happens after the invoice has been issued and numbered, so fixing it takes a corrective or a void.

applies_to.scope: Lines under the cash-basis regime (regime key 07).

legal_basis.quote: Si ClaveRegimen = “07”: ✓ CalificacionOperacion no puede ser “S2”, “N1”, “N2”. ✓ OperacionExenta no puede ser “E2”, “E3”, “E4” y “E5”.

incorrect.text: A cash-basis business puts an intra-EU supply of goods (EXENTA_ART_25) under regime key 07.

correct.text: Only domestic, subject operations go under 07; the intra-EU supply goes under its own regime and exemption.

rules.title: The tax and the billing record are expressed in euros
rules.statement: An invoice may state its amounts in another currency, but the VAT charged is expressed in euros, and every amount in the billing record is in euros. BeeL. invoices only in euros, so both hold for every invoice it issues.
rules.why: AEAT only takes tax and record amounts in euros; a foreign-currency amount would have to be converted at the exchange rate the law sets.

applies_to.scope: Every invoice.

legal_basis.quote: Los importes que figuran en las facturas podrán expresarse en cualquier moneda, a condición de que el importe del Impuesto que, en su caso, se repercuta se exprese en euros, utilizando a tal efecto el tipo de cambio a que se refiere el artículo 79.Once de la Ley del Impuesto.

Todos los importes monetarios que consten en el registro de facturación de alta deberán expresarse en euros. Cuando la factura se hubiese expedido en una unidad de cuenta o divisa distinta del euro tendrá que efectuarse en el registro la correspondiente conversión.

incorrect.text: Expecting BeeL. to register a dollar invoice and convert it for AEAT.

correct.text: Converting the price to euros before sending it, as TAX-013 says.

rules.title: Send every amount in euros
rules.statement: The API has no currency field: every amount you send is read as euros. Convert foreign-currency prices to euros before sending them; you may mention the original currency in the notes.
rules.why: A price sent in dollars or pounds is invoiced, taxed and registered with AEAT as that many euros, and only a corrective fixes it.

incorrect.text: Passing through a Stripe charge of 100 USD as unit_price: 100.

correct.text: Converting it first and sending the euro amount, with the original amount in notes.

rules.title: The surcharge rate matches the VAT rate of its line
rules.statement: A line sold to a retailer under the surcharge regime carries the surcharge rate the law pairs with that line's VAT rate, and goes under regime key 18; a line under 18 always carries a surcharge. Add it only when the buyer has told you they are under the regime.
rules.why: A surcharge that does not match the VAT rate charges the wrong tax, and AEAT does not accept the pair in the record.

applies_to.scope: Supplies of goods to a retailer under the equivalence surcharge regime (regime key 18).
