legal_basis.quote: Los tipos del recargo de equivalencia serán los siguientes: 1.º Con carácter general, el 5,2 por ciento. 2.º Para las entregas de bienes a las que resulte aplicable el tipo impositivo establecido en el artículo 91, apartado uno de esta Ley, el 1,4 por ciento. 3.º Para las entregas de bienes a las que sea aplicable el tipo impositivo previsto en el artículo 91, apartado dos de esta Ley, el 0,50 por ciento.
Si TipoImpositivo es 21 sólo se admitirán TipoRecargoEquivalencia = 5,2 ó 1,75. - Si TipoImpositivo es 10 sólo se admitirá TipoRecargoEquivalencia = 1,4.

incorrect.text: A 10 % line with the 5.2 surcharge: the API answers INVALID_IVA_SURCHARGE_PAIR.

correct.text: A 21 % line with its 5.2 surcharge under regime 18.

rules.title: Supplies with the surcharge go on separate invoices
rules.statement: Document the supplies that carry the equivalence surcharge on their own invoices, stating the surcharge rate and amount. BeeL. applies the surcharge line by line and does not stop you from mixing lines with and without it.
rules.why: The law requires separate invoices for these supplies; an invoice that mixes them does not meet the invoicing obligations.

applies_to.scope: Supplies of goods on which the equivalence surcharge is charged.

legal_basis.quote: Los empresarios o profesionales que efectúen entregas de bienes en las que deba repercutirse el recargo de equivalencia deberán, en todo caso, expedir facturas separadas para documentar dichas entregas, consignando en ellas el tipo del recargo que se haya aplicado y su importe.

incorrect.text: One invoice to a retailer with goods for resale under the surcharge and a repair service without it.

correct.text: Two invoices: one for the goods with the surcharge, one for the service.

rules.title: Do not send an issue date
rules.statement: The API has no writable issue date: an invoice is dated the day it is issued, and a scheduled one the day it is scheduled for. To record when the sale happened, send operation_date.
rules.why: Backdating or postdating an invoice is not possible: the issue date is the day its billing record is generated. An integration that tries to set it ends up with invoices dated differently from what it expects.

incorrect.text: Trying to send an issue date set to the last day of the previous month to close the month's invoicing.

correct.text: Issuing today, with the date the service was provided as operation_date.

rules.title: The issue date is the day the billing record is generated
rules.statement: An invoice's issue date is the date its billing record is generated, which is also, as a rule, the day the record is sent: it cannot be later than today nor set to an earlier day. BeeL. dates the invoice when you issue it.
rules.why: An issue date that does not match the record's makes the record inconsistent; AEAT rejects an issue date in the future.

applies_to.scope: Invoices under VeriFactu.

legal_basis.norm: AEAT, Preguntas frecuentes SIF y VERI*FACTU
legal_basis.quote: La fecha de expedición de la factura debe coincidir con la de generación del registro de facturación. Ambas fechas, generalmente deben corresponderse con la fecha en que se remite el Registro de facturación.
La FechaExpedicionFactura no podrá ser superior a la fecha actual.
deberán generar automáticamente un registro de facturación de alta de forma simultánea o inmediatamente anterior a la expedición de cada factura.

incorrect.text: Keeping a month of invoices as drafts and expecting them to carry the dates of each sale when you issue them at month end.

correct.text: Issuing each invoice when the sale happens, or issuing later with each sale's date as operation_date and within the deadlines.

rules.title: The operation date is never after the issue date
rules.statement: operation_date is the day the operation took place or the advance payment was received, so it cannot be later than the issue date. To bill before delivering, invoice the advance payment with the day you received it.
rules.why: AEAT does not accept an operation dated in the future except in two special regimes; an invoice dated before the operation it documents is not consistent.

legal_basis.quote: el campo FechaOperacion solo podrá ser superior a la fecha actual, si ClaveRegimen= "14" o "15”.

incorrect.text: Issuing today an invoice for next week's delivery with that date as operation_date: the API answers OPERATION_DATE_AFTER_ISSUE_DATE.

correct.text: Issuing the invoice on the delivery day, or invoicing now the advance payment you already received.

rules.title: Send the operation date when it differs from the issue date
rules.statement: When the goods were delivered, the service provided or the advance received on a day other than the issue date, send that day as operation_date. Omitted, the invoice takes the issue date as the operation date.
rules.why: The operation date decides the VAT rate and the tax period. Without it, an invoice issued in October for a September sale says the sale happened in October.

legal_basis.quote: La fecha en que se hayan efectuado las operaciones que se documentan o en la que, en su caso, se haya recibido el pago anticipado, siempre que se trate de una fecha distinta a la de expedición de la factura.

incorrect.text: Issuing on 2 October the invoice for work finished on 30 September without operation_date.

correct.text: Sending the day the work was finished.

rules.title: Invoice consumers when the operation takes place
rules.statement: When the customer is a consumer, issue the invoice at the moment the operation is performed.
rules.why: An invoice to a consumer issued days later breaks the issuing deadline, and under VeriFactu its record reaches AEAT late too.

applies_to.scope: Operations with a recipient that is not a business or professional acting as such.

legal_basis.quote: Las facturas deberán ser expedidas en el momento de realizarse la operación.

incorrect.text: An online shop collects the day's orders and issues their invoices the following week.

correct.text: The shop issues each invoice when the order is completed.

rules.title: Invoice businesses before day 16 of the following month
rules.statement: When the customer is a business or professional, issue the invoice before day 16 of the month after the one in which the VAT accrued.
rules.why: An invoice issued after the deadline breaches the invoicing obligations and can be sanctioned, even though the sale was declared.

applies_to.scope: Operations with a business or professional acting as such.

legal_basis.quote: No obstante, cuando el destinatario de la operación sea un empresario o profesional que actúe como tal, las facturas deberán expedirse antes del día 16 del mes siguiente a aquél en que se haya producido el devengo del Impuesto correspondiente a la citada operación.

incorrect.text: Invoicing on 20 October a service to a company that was completed on 25 September.

correct.text: Issuing that invoice by 15 October, with operation_date set to 25 September.

rules.title: One invoice for a month of operations, issued in time
rules.statement: You may put several operations for the same customer in one invoice only if they all took place in the same calendar month. Issue it by the last day of that month or, when the customer is a business, before day 16 of the next one.
rules.why: Grouping operations from different months in one invoice, or issuing it late, breaches the invoicing rules even when every operation is on it.

applies_to.scope: Recapitulative invoices: several operations for the same customer in one invoice.

legal_basis.quote: Podrán incluirse en una sola factura distintas operaciones realizadas en distintas fechas para un mismo destinatario, siempre que las mismas se hayan efectuado dentro de un mismo mes natural. 2. Estas facturas deberán ser expedidas como máximo el último día del mes natural en el que se hayan efectuado las operaciones que se documenten en ellas.

incorrect.text: One invoice to a company for deliveries made between 20 August and 10 September.

correct.text: One invoice for the August deliveries and another for the September ones, each issued in time.

rules.title: Deliver the invoice to the customer in time
rules.statement: Send the original invoice to the customer when you issue it or, when the customer is a business, before day 16 of the month after the accrual. BeeL. can email it, but does not track the deadline.
rules.why: An invoice the customer never receives cannot be deducted by them, and delivering it is an obligation of the issuer.

legal_basis.quote: La obligación de remisión de las facturas que se establece en el artículo 17 deberá cumplirse en el mismo momento de su expedición o bien, cuando el destinatario sea un empresario o profesional que actúe como tal, antes del día 16 del mes siguiente a aquél en que se haya producido el devengo del Impuesto

incorrect.text: Issuing invoices through the API and never delivering them, assuming AEAT's record reaches the customer.

correct.text: Emailing the PDF from BeeL. once it is ready, or delivering it through your own channel.

rules.title: VAT is charged by invoice within 1 year of accrual
rules.statement: VAT is passed on to the customer through an invoice, and the right to charge it is lost 1 year after the VAT accrued.
rules.why: Invoicing or correcting upwards after that window leaves the issuer paying a VAT it can no longer charge to the customer.

applies_to.scope: Every operation that accrues VAT.

legal_basis.quote: Se perderá el derecho a la repercusión cuando haya transcurrido un año desde la fecha del devengo.

incorrect.text: Finding in 2027 a service delivered in March 2025 that was never invoiced, and invoicing it with VAT.

correct.text: Reconciling unbilled operations every month, so each is invoiced within the deadlines.

rules.title: Invoice advance payments when you receive them
rules.statement: A payment received before the operation is invoiced too, with the day you received it as operation_date; the final invoice then covers the rest. Exempt intra-EU supplies of goods are the exception.
rules.why: VAT accrues when an advance is received, so an advance without its invoice leaves VAT accrued and never charged.

applies_to.scope: Payments received before the goods are delivered or the service is provided.

legal_basis.quote: También deberá expedirse factura y copia de esta por los pagos recibidos con anterioridad a la realización de las entregas de bienes o prestaciones de servicios por las que deba asimismo cumplirse esta obligación conforme al párrafo anterior, a excepción de las entregas de bienes exentas del Impuesto sobre el Valor Añadido por aplicación de lo dispuesto en el artículo 25 de la Ley del Impuesto.

incorrect.text: Collecting a 30 % deposit on a kitchen installation and invoicing everything only when the work is finished.

correct.text: Invoicing the deposit the day it is received, and the remaining 70 % when the installation is completed.

rules.title: Adapted billing systems are mandatory from 1 January 2027 or 1 July 2027
rules.statement: Corporate-tax payers must invoice with a billing system adapted to the regulation before 1 January 2027, and the other taxpayers it covers before 1 July 2027. Which group you are in, and whether the regulation applies to you, is yours to determine.
rules.why: Invoicing after the deadline with a system that does not meet the regulation is an infringement of the taxpayer, not of the software.

applies_to.scope: Taxpayers under the billing-systems regulation; those keeping their VAT books through the SII are outside it.

legal_basis.quote: antes del 1 de enero de 2027. El resto de obligados tributarios mencionados en el artículo 3.1 deberán tener operativos los citados sistemas informáticos antes del 1 de julio de 2027.

incorrect.text: A company subject to corporate tax plans its switch to an adapted billing system for spring 2027.

correct.text: The company enables VeriFactu and tests its integration in the sandbox during 2026.

rules.title: Plan for mandatory B2B electronic invoices
rules.statement: Once the ministerial order that RD 238/2026 depends on is in force, businesses will have to issue structured electronic invoices to other Spanish businesses, first the largest ones and later the rest. Until that order is published the obligation does not apply; watch for it.
rules.why: The deadline starts counting from an order that has not been published yet, and adapting invoicing to structured formats takes time.

applies_to.scope: Invoices to businesses and professionals established in Spain, once RD 238/2026 applies.

legal_basis.quote: Será obligatoria la factura electrónica en las condiciones establecidas en la Ley 56/2007, de 28 de diciembre, de Medidas de Impulso de la sociedad de la Información, y en su normativa de desarrollo cuando el destinatario de la operación sea un empresario o profesional que tenga en España la sede de su actividad económica

la aplicación efectiva de este real decreto quedará diferida en los siguientes términos, contados desde la entrada en vigor de la orden ministerial prevista en el apartado 1 de la disposición final tercera

incorrect.text: Assuming a PDF sent by email will keep being enough for every business customer indefinitely.

correct.text: Tracking the publication of the ministerial order and planning a structured format for invoices to Spanish businesses.

rules.title: Every invoice carries the tax QR code
rules.statement: An invoice issued with a billing system carries the tax QR code, whether it is a full or a simplified invoice. BeeL. returns the QR data on the invoice and prints the QR on every PDF it renders for an invoice under VeriFactu.
rules.why: The QR is how the recipient checks the invoice with AEAT. A document without it is not the invoice the regulation describes.

applies_to.scope: Invoices of a company under VeriFactu, full or simplified.

legal_basis.quote: La representación gráfica del contenido parcial de la factura mediante un código “QR”.
deberá incluirse, además, lo contenido en el apartado 5 del artículo 6 de este Reglamento.

incorrect.text: Sending the customer a document of your own with the invoice data and no QR.

correct.text: Sending the PDF BeeL. renders, which carries the QR, or printing qr_base64 on your own document.

rules.title: Wait for the QR before you distribute the PDF
rules.statement: Do not render or send an invoice under VeriFactu before its QR exists. The QR data appears with submission_status: PENDING, a few seconds after issuing; BeeL. generates the final PDF only then, and the invoice.pdf.generated webhook says it is ready.
rules.why: Right after the issue call the invoice reads NOT_SUBMITTED and has no QR. A document rendered at that moment goes out without it.

applies_to.scope: Invoices of a company under VeriFactu.

incorrect.text: Rendering your own PDF from the response of the issue call, which carries no qr_url yet.

correct.text: Waiting for the invoice.pdf.generated webhook, or reading the invoice again until verifactu.qr_url is present.

rules.title: The QR measures between 30 mm and 40 mm
rules.statement: The QR code printed on an invoice measures at least 30 mm × 30 mm and at most 40 mm × 40 mm.
rules.why: A smaller QR may not scan, and the Orden fixes the range: neither smaller nor larger.

applies_to.scope: Any document that carries the QR, including one you render.

legal_basis.quote: El código «QR» deberá tener un tamaño entre 30x30 y 40x40 milímetros y seguir las especificaciones de la norma ISO/IEC 18004.

legal_basis.norm: AEAT, Preguntas frecuentes SIF y VERI*FACTU
legal_basis.article: Remisión de información por el receptor / QR
legal_basis.quote: no puede ser menor de 30x30 mm no puede ser mayor de 40x40 mm.

incorrect.text: Scaling the qr_base64 image down to fit a narrow header.

correct.text: Placing the image at a fixed physical size inside the range, whatever the page layout.

rules.title: The QR follows ISO/IEC 18004 with error correction M
rules.statement: A QR code generated for an invoice follows ISO/IEC 18004 and uses error-correction level M. Set it when you encode qr_url with your own library.
rules.why: Other levels change the density of the code, and the Orden fixes this one.

applies_to.scope: A QR you generate yourself from qr_url.

legal_basis.quote: Para la generación del código «QR» se empleará el nivel M (medio) de corrección de errores.

incorrect.text: Encoding qr_url with a library that defaults to error-correction level L.

correct.text: Encoding it with level M, or printing qr_base64 unchanged.

rules.title: Use qr_url exactly as returned
rules.statement: Do not build or change the URL the QR encodes: use qr_url as BeeL. returns it. It carries only the four parameters AEAT requires, the issuer NIF, the number, the issue date and the amount AEAT registered.
rules.why: The URL has to match the registered record. A URL built from your own invoice total, or with extra parameters, points AEAT at an invoice that does not exist.

applies_to.scope: Invoices of a company under VeriFactu.

legal_basis.quote: b) Información de la factura que formará parte de la «URL»: 1.º NIF del obligado a expedir la factura. 2.º Número de serie y número de la factura expedida. 3.º Fecha de expedición de la factura. 4.º Importe total de la factura.

legal_basis.norm: AEAT, Detalle de las especificaciones técnicas del código QR de la factura (v0.5.0)
legal_basis.quote: IMPORTANTE: este parámetro nunca podrá incorporarse en la «URL» que va en el código «QR» de la factura

incorrect.text: Rebuilding the URL from your own data, with the invoice total including IRPF, or adding formato=json.

correct.text: Encoding the qr_url string from the invoice, unchanged.

rules.title: The VeriFactu legend goes just below the QR
rules.statement: Just below the QR, print «Factura verificable en la sede electrónica de la AEAT» or «VERI*FACTU», in a type size at least equal to the rest of the invoice data. Print it only on invoices whose record goes to AEAT.
rules.why: The legend tells the recipient the invoice was sent to AEAT and can be checked there; on an invoice that was not, it would say something false.

applies_to.scope: Any document that carries the QR of an invoice registered under VeriFactu.

legal_basis.quote: Estas facturas, sean electrónicas o no, incorporarán además la frase “Factura verificable en la sede electrónica de la AEAT” o “VERI*FACTU” únicamente en aquellos casos en los que el sistema informático realice la remisión de todos los registros de facturación a la Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria

legal_basis.norm: AEAT, Detalle de las especificaciones técnicas del código QR de la factura (v0.5.0)
legal_basis.quote: justo debajo del código «QR» deberá aparecer la frase «Factura verificable en la sede electrónica de la AEAT» o «VERI*FACTU», preferiblemente centrada con respecto al código «QR».

incorrect.text: Printing the legend in small print in the footer, away from the QR.

correct.text: Printing «Factura verificable en la sede electrónica de la AEAT» centred just below the QR, as large as the invoice lines.

rules.title: «QR tributario:» goes just above the QR
rules.statement: Above the QR, print the text «QR tributario:», preferably centred on it, in a type size at least equal to the rest of the invoice data.
rules.why: AEAT's specification presents the QR with this label, so that the recipient knows which code to scan.

applies_to.scope: Any document that carries the QR, including one you render.

legal_basis.norm: AEAT, Detalle de las especificaciones técnicas del código QR de la factura (v0.5.0)
legal_basis.quote: La presentación del código «QR» incluirá también un texto que siempre deberá ir precediéndolo: «QR tributario:», y que se situará encima del propio código «QR» (preferiblemente centrado con respecto a este)

incorrect.text: Printing the QR on its own, or with a label in a smaller font than the invoice lines.

correct.text: Printing «QR tributario:» centred above the QR, at the same size as the invoice data.

rules.title: The QR goes once, at the top of the first page
rules.statement: Place the QR at the beginning of the invoice, before its content, near the top margin and preferably centred (otherwise top left). On an invoice of several pages it appears once, on the first page.
rules.why: AEAT's specification fixes where the recipient finds the code; a QR repeated or buried in the footer departs from it.

applies_to.scope: Any document that carries the QR, including one you render.

legal_basis.norm: AEAT, Detalle de las especificaciones técnicas del código QR de la factura (v0.5.0)
legal_basis.quote: Si la factura ocupara varias páginas, el código «QR» aparecería una única vez, en la primera página.

legal_basis.norm: AEAT, Preguntas frecuentes SIF y VERI*FACTU
legal_basis.article: Remisión de información por el receptor / QR
legal_basis.quote: El QR tributario solo debe aparecer una vez, al principio de la factura y antes del contenido de esta.

incorrect.text: Repeating the QR in the footer of every page.

correct.text: Printing it once, at the top of page one, centred between the margins.

rules.title: Keep a blank margin around the QR
rules.statement: Leave at least 2 mm of blank space on all four sides of the QR (6 mm recommended), with enough contrast against the background.
rules.why: Without a quiet zone, text or lines next to the code stop it from scanning.

applies_to.scope: Any document that carries the QR, including one you render.

legal_basis.norm: AEAT, Detalle de las especificaciones técnicas del código QR de la factura (v0.5.0)
legal_basis.quote: se deben mantener como mínimo 2 milímetros de espacio vacío (en blanco) alrededor de los cuatro lados del código «QR», recomendándose que sean 6 milímetros.

incorrect.text: Placing the QR flush against a table border.

correct.text: Keeping a white margin around it on every side.

rules.title: A structured e-invoice carries the QR URL as a field
rules.statement: When you send an invoice as a structured electronic invoice, include the qr_url as a separate field; the QR image itself is then not needed. A PDF still shows the QR image.
rules.why: In a structured file there is no image to scan: the URL is how the recipient reaches AEAT's check.

applies_to.scope: Invoices you send as structured e-invoices (Facturae, UBL and similar).

legal_basis.quote: En caso de tratarse de una factura electrónica, destinada al intercambio de su información de forma estructurada
se deberá incluir como un campo independiente la «URL» contenida en el código «QR», no siendo necesario incluir el propio código «QR».

incorrect.text: Converting the invoice to a structured format and dropping the QR data.

correct.text: Mapping verifactu.qr_url to its own field of the structured invoice.

rules.title: Each issued invoice gets a billing record built from its data
rules.statement: When an invoice is issued, its billing record (registro de alta) is generated at that moment from the invoice's own data: issuer, recipient, number, dates, type, description, totals, regime and the tax breakdown of each line. BeeL. generates it; you classify each line correctly.
rules.why: The record is what AEAT registers. A line classified wrongly on the invoice is registered wrongly too, and only a later document can change it.

applies_to.scope: Invoices of a company under VeriFactu.

legal_basis.quote: deberán generar automáticamente un registro de facturación de alta de forma simultánea o inmediatamente anterior a la expedición de cada factura.
El registro informático de facturación de alta incluirá la siguiente información:

incorrect.text: Classifying an exempt line as a 0 % taxed line: AEAT registers a taxed operation.

correct.text: Sending the exemption reason on the line, so the record carries the exempt base and its cause.

rules.title: The record goes to AEAT as soon as the invoice is issued
rules.statement: Every billing record is sent to AEAT continuously and automatically, as the invoice is issued. BeeL. submits it without a call from you; issue each invoice when the operation happens rather than holding drafts to issue in batches.
rules.why: Under VERI*FACTU the immediacy of the submission is part of the record's security. There is no per-invoice switch and no later submit step.

applies_to.scope: Invoices of a company under VeriFactu.

legal_basis.quote: de forma continuada, segura, correcta, íntegra, automática, consecutiva, instantánea y fehaciente todos los registros de facturación generados

legal_basis.norm: AEAT, Preguntas frecuentes SIF y VERI*FACTU
legal_basis.quote: La inmediatez del envío a VERI*FACTU es parte del sistema de seguridad de los registros de facturación, por lo que se aplica en todos los casos.

incorrect.text: Keeping a day's sales as drafts and issuing them all at midnight.

correct.text: Issuing each invoice when the sale happens; BeeL. submits its record straight away.

rules.title: VERI*FACTU is kept until the end of the year
rules.statement: Once a NIF has sent its first record under VERI*FACTU, it keeps that modality at least until 31 December of that year. Leaving it is declared in a submission before the year ends.
rules.why: The option is annual: switching a NIF off in the middle of the year breaks the obligation it took on with its first submission.

applies_to.scope: A NIF that has started sending records under VERI*FACTU.

legal_basis.quote: La opción en el uso de los «Sistemas de emisión de facturas verificables» se prolongará, al menos, hasta la finalización del año natural en el que se haya producido, de forma efectiva, el primer envío de los registros de facturación.
El funcionamiento como «VERI*FACTU» deberá mantenerse siempre al menos hasta el final del último año en que haya funcionado como tal, es decir, hasta el 31 de diciembre de dicho año.

incorrect.text: Turning VeriFactu off for a NIF in June after it started submitting in March.

correct.text: Deciding before year end whether the NIF continues next year.

rules.title: BeeL. generates the hash and the chain
rules.statement: Do not compute a hash or chain records yourself. Each record carries a hash and refers to the previous record of the same issuer; BeeL. generates both when the invoice is issued.
rules.why: The chain is what makes the records traceable from the first to the last. A second chain kept by your system would not be the one AEAT receives.

applies_to.scope: Invoices of a company under VeriFactu.

legal_basis.quote: La trazabilidad de los registros de facturación, que deberán estar encadenados de manera que pueda verificarse su rastro siguiendo su secuencia de creación desde el primero al último.
deberán añadir una huella o «hash» a los registros de facturación de alta y de anulación
4.º Los primeros 64 caracteres de la huella o «hash» del registro de facturación inmediatamente anterior.

incorrect.text: Computing a SHA-256 over your own invoice fields and sending it with the invoice.

correct.text: Issuing through BeeL. and reading verifactu.invoice_hash from the invoice if you need it.

rules.title: One chain per NIF, one company per NIF
rules.statement: Records of each taxpayer are kept apart, in a chain of their own. Create one company per NIF and issue each invoice from the company of the NIF that issues it; show your users which one they are operating.
rules.why: A system used by several taxpayers must keep their records separate and meet the requirements for each one; an invoice issued from the wrong company lands in another taxpayer's chain.

applies_to.scope: Accounts that invoice for several NIFs.

legal_basis.quote: siempre que los registros de facturación de cada obligado tributario se encuentren diferenciados y se cumplan los requisitos exigidos en este Reglamento por separado para cada uno de los obligados tributarios
Para un determinado obligado tributario, cada sistema informático producirá una única cadena de registros de facturación

incorrect.text: Issuing the invoices of two businesses from one company, told apart by a series prefix.

correct.text: Creating a company per NIF and targeting each call at the right one.

rules.title: No certificate is needed to sign records
rules.statement: Records sent under VERI*FACTU need no electronic signature: their hash is enough. Neither the issuer nor the integrator hands BeeL. a digital certificate for the submissions.
rules.why: Integrations that plan a signing step, or ask their customers for a certificate, add work the regulation does not require.

applies_to.scope: Invoices of a company under VeriFactu.

legal_basis.quote: no tendrán la obligación de realizar la firma electrónica de los registros de facturación a la que se refiere el artículo 12 de este Reglamento, siendo suficiente con que calculen la huella o «hash» de dichos registros.

incorrect.text: Asking each customer to upload a certificate so that their invoices can be signed.

correct.text: Asking the NIF holder to sign the AEAT representation once, and nothing else.

rules.title: Keep invoicing when AEAT is unreachable
rules.statement: Do not stop invoicing because AEAT is unavailable. The invoice is issued and numbered as usual; BeeL. retries its submission on its own and flags a record that goes out on a later day than the issue date as a late submission.
rules.why: An incident in the submission never justifies stopping invoicing, and records have to be sent as soon as it is possible, in order and flagged as late.

applies_to.scope: Invoices of a company under VeriFactu.

legal_basis.quote: se deberá proceder a la remisión de los registros de facturación en cuanto sea posible, respetando el orden temporal de generación de los registros de facturación.

legal_basis.norm: AEAT, Preguntas frecuentes SIF y VERI*FACTU
legal_basis.quote: Incidencias como las mencionada, que afectan a la remisión a la AEAT , NO suponen en ningún caso que deba interrumpirse la facturación de la empresa.

incorrect.text: Queueing sales in your system until AEAT is back, then issuing them with the day's date.

correct.text: Issuing through BeeL. as usual and following each invoice with the verifactu.status.updated webhook.

rules.title: Follow submission_status and fix what AEAT rejects
rules.statement: Track each issued invoice's verifactu.submission_status (NOT_SUBMITTED, PENDING, ACCEPTED, REJECTED) through the verifactu.status.updated webhook and a periodic reconciliation. A REJECTED invoice is not registered: read its error_code and fix it.
rules.why: A 200 on issue means BeeL. accepted the invoice, not that AEAT registered it. A rejection nobody reads leaves an invoice outside AEAT's records.

applies_to.scope: Invoices of a company under VeriFactu.

incorrect.text: Treating the 200 of the issue call as proof that AEAT registered the invoice.

correct.text: Subscribing to verifactu.status.updated and, every few hours, listing invoices still NOT_SUBMITTED or PENDING to reconcile them.

rules.title: Check the data AEAT accepted with errors
rules.statement: When AEAT accepts a record but reports an error (ACCEPTED with an error_code), check the data it flagged, usually the recipient's NIF and name. If it was wrong, issue a corrective invoice with the right data; if it was right, nothing else is needed.
rules.why: A record accepted with errors stays in AEAT with those errors until a later document fixes them.

applies_to.scope: Invoices ACCEPTED with an error_code.

legal_basis.quote: Los registros de facturación con errores admisibles serán “aceptados” y registrados por los sistemas de la AEAT, pero deberán ser subsanados para poder llevar a cabo el tratamiento y validación de los mismos.

incorrect.text: Reading ACCEPTED and ignoring the error_code next to it.

correct.text: Reading error_message, confirming the customer's NIF was mistyped, and issuing an R1 corrective with the right one.

rules.title: Resubmission fixes only causes outside the invoice
rules.statement: Resubmitting a record (subsanación) is only for a problem that needs no corrective invoice: a cause outside the invoice's data, such as an issuer not yet in the census or an unsigned representation. There is no API for it; once the cause is fixed, ask BeeL. support to resubmit. Any error in what the invoice says is fixed with a corrective.
rules.why: The record is immutable: resubmitting it does not change the invoice, so it cannot fix a wrong amount, customer or description.

applies_to.scope: Records rejected or accepted with errors.

legal_basis.quote: Solo podrá llevarse a cabo una subsanación cuando no se trate de una causa que exija la emisión de una factura rectificativa (u otro mecanismo contemplado en el Reglamento de Facturación).

decision.when: Nothing on the invoice is wrong: AEAT refused the record for a cause outside it (issuer not in the census, representation not signed).
decision.then: Fix the cause, then ask BeeL. support to resubmit the unchanged record (subsanación).

incorrect.text: Asking support to resubmit an invoice whose recipient NIF was wrong.

correct.text: Signing the missing representation, then asking support to resubmit the rejected record unchanged.

rules.title: The NIF holder signs the AEAT representation first
rules.statement: Before a NIF issues real invoices under VeriFactu, its holder signs the AEAT representation that lets BeeL. submit the records on the taxpayer's behalf. Enabling VeriFactu or issuing without it is rejected.
rules.why: Records are sent by the taxpayer or by someone acting as its representative. Without the signed representation there is nobody entitled to send them.

applies_to.scope: Production (Live) NIFs; sandbox needs no representation.

legal_basis.quote: La remisión podrá ser efectuada por el propio obligado tributario o por un tercero que actúe en su representación

incorrect.text: Enabling VeriFactu in Live for a new NIF straight after creating it: the API answers VERIFACTU_REPRESENTATION_REQUIRED.

correct.text: Generating the representation document, having the holder sign it, uploading it, and then enabling VeriFactu.

rules.title: Tax amounts are base times rate
rules.statement: The tax amount of each breakdown equals its base times its rate, with the same sign as the base. BeeL. computes it from the rate of each line: the API takes rates, never tax amounts.
rules.why: AEAT checks the tax amount against base × rate, allowing 10 € of difference, and rejects the record beyond it.

applies_to.scope: Every taxed line.

legal_basis.quote: CuotaRepercutida y BaseImponibleOimporteNoSujeto deben tener el mismo signo.

incorrect.text: Keeping a tax amount computed by your system and expecting BeeL. to register it.

correct.text: Sending the rate on each line (main_tax) and reading the computed amounts from the response.

rules.title: Keep copies of issued invoices for the limitation period
rules.statement: The issuing business keeps copies of the invoices it issues, with their original content and in order, for the limitation period of the General Tax Law: at least four years from the filing deadline, and longer in some cases.
rules.why: AEAT can ask for any invoice within that period. Keeping copies is the issuer's duty even when someone else keeps them materially.

applies_to.scope: Every issued invoice.

legal_basis.quote: Los documentos deben conservarse con su contenido original, ordenadamente y en los plazos y con las condiciones fijados por este Reglamento.
las copias de las facturas expedidas, deberán conservarse, incluso por medios electrónicos, durante el plazo de prescripción del Impuesto.
Prescribirán a los cuatro años los siguientes derechos:
Los empresarios conservarán los libros, correspondencia, documentación y justificantes concernientes a su negocio, debidamente ordenados, durante seis años

incorrect.text: Assuming invoices can be discarded once the quarter is filed.

correct.text: Keeping every issued invoice, PDF and data, for the whole period, in order.

rules.title: AEAT keeps the records, not your invoices
rules.statement: Under VERI*FACTU AEAT keeps the billing records, but a record does not contain the whole invoice: its lines, for one, are not in it. Keep the full invoices yourself.
rules.why: Relying on AEAT's copy leaves you without the detail of each invoice when you are asked for it.

applies_to.scope: Invoices of a company under VeriFactu.

legal_basis.norm: AEAT, Aclaraciones a dudas de los desarrolladores (v1.3)
legal_basis.article: 13. Conservación de registros en VERI*FACTU y libros registros
legal_basis.quote: Por lo que se refiere a las Facturas Completas, estas deben conservarse en la [...] medida en que el Registro no contiene la totalidad del detalle de las facturas (por ejemplo las líneas de facturación).

incorrect.text: Keeping only the AEAT registration numbers and discarding the invoices.

correct.text: Keeping each invoice's PDF and data, lines included.

rules.title: Export your invoices and records before leaving
rules.statement: The issuing business must be able to reach its invoices and billing records for the whole conservation period, also after changing systems. Export the invoices, their PDFs and their records before closing the account.
rules.why: The duty to keep them does not end when the business stops using a system. What is not exported before closing is no longer at hand.

legal_basis.quote: se encuentren o no en el sistema informático que los generó, e incluso cuando se haya cambiado de sistema informático.

incorrect.text: Closing the account at the end of the year with no copy of that year's invoices.

correct.text: Exporting the invoices and downloading their PDFs first.

rules.title: Invoices kept electronically are reachable on request
rules.statement: Invoices kept electronically must be available online, so that AEAT can view, download and use them on request without undue delay.
rules.why: Copies you cannot produce when AEAT asks count as copies you do not have.

applies_to.scope: Invoices kept by electronic means.

legal_basis.quote: Los documentos conservados por medios electrónicos deberán ser gestionados y conservados por medios que garanticen un acceso en línea a los datos así como su carga remota y utilización por parte de la Administración tributaria ante cualquier solicitud de esta y sin demora injustificada.

incorrect.text: Archiving the invoices on a disk nobody can reach remotely.

correct.text: Keeping them where they can be searched and downloaded when AEAT asks.

rules.title: Invoice only with compliant, unaltered software
rules.statement: Issue invoices only with a billing system that meets the regulation and has not been altered. Holding software that does not is an infringement of its own, fined 50,000 € per financial year.
rules.why: The fine applies for merely having the software, whatever it was used for.

applies_to.scope: Every business subject to the billing-system regulation.

legal_basis.quote: Constituye infracción tributaria la tenencia de los sistemas o programas informáticos o electrónicos que no se ajusten a lo establecido en el artículo 29.2.j) de esta Ley
se sancionará con multa pecuniaria fija de 50.000 euros por cada ejercicio

incorrect.text: Keeping a tool that edits or deletes issued invoices next to the invoicing flow.

correct.text: Issuing, correcting and voiding only through documents the system records.

rules.title: Invoicing breaches are fined in proportion to the operations
rules.statement: Issuing, delivering, correcting and keeping invoices are obligations; breaking them is fined at 1 % of the operations involved, 2 % when invoices were not issued or kept, and up to 75 % when they carry false data.
rules.why: A flow that skips invoices, or corrects them by issuing new ones with altered data, turns into a fine proportional to the amounts involved.

applies_to.scope: Every business with invoicing obligations.

legal_basis.quote: Constituye infracción tributaria el incumplimiento de las obligaciones de facturación, entre otras, la de expedición, remisión, rectificación y conservación de facturas
La sanción consistirá en multa pecuniaria proporcional del uno por ciento del importe del conjunto de las operaciones que hayan originado la infracción.

incorrect.text: Leaving sales without an invoice, or fixing a mistake by issuing a second invoice for the same sale.

correct.text: Invoicing every operation and fixing mistakes with a corrective invoice.
